Peter — I know my
team and I have been reaching out a lot about my reelection race, but
today, I hope you’ll let me share a story about my very first campaign.

When I first ran for Congress in Wisconsin, no one thought I could win —
especially when an extremely popular challenger entered the race.

I remember huddling with one of my staffers at the time. She said, “Well,
Tammy, maybe you want to rethink what you’re doing because it’s going to
be tough.”

I looked her right in the eye and asked, “Do you think I should wait my
turn?”

Then I said this: I believe that women have to run and not wait our turn —
especially when it’s hard. We can’t wait until we get a tap on our
shoulder or we’ll never get anywhere.

Defying the odds, I ended up winning that race, and became the very first
woman elected to the House of Representatives from Wisconsin. And that was
just the first time our team would make history.

When I ran for U.S. Senate in 2012, an incredible team of grassroots
supporters like you fought alongside me — even as some people wrote us
off. You helped me become the first woman elected to the Senate from our
state and the first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history.

And then in 2018, despite being a top target for national Republicans and
enduring over a year of attacks, you stood with me again, and together, we
won.

I’m used to being written off,
Peter. But time and again,
grassroots supporters like you have helped us defy the odds. And we’ll
need to do it once more, because the fight to protect my seat is tougher
than ever before.

Eric Hovde and his Republican allies have already spent more than $51
million to buy this seat, and they’re currently outspending us statewide.

Recent polls show this race tightening, multiple elections experts have
downgraded our race rating in Hovde’s favor, and now, Mitch McConnell’s
super PAC launched $17 million on attack ads against me — which he
wouldn’t do unless he knew Hovde could win and flip Wisconsin red.

Protecting this seat while Republicans are outspending us on the airwaves
won’t be easy, but together, I know we can defy the odds once again.

clean_body: [ ]TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE Peter — I know my team and I have been reaching out a lot about my reelection race, but today, I hope you’ll let me share a story about my very first campaign. When I first ran for Congress in Wisconsin, no one thought I could win — especially when an extremely popular challenger entered the race. I remember huddling with one of my staffers at the time. She said, “Well, Tammy, maybe you want to rethink what you’re doing because it’s going to be tough.” I looked her right in the eye and asked, “Do you think I should wait my turn?” Then I said this: I believe that women have to run and not wait our turn — especially when it’s hard. We can’t wait until we get a tap on our shoulder or we’ll never get anywhere. Defying the odds, I ended up winning that race, and became the very first woman elected to the House of Representatives from Wisconsin. And that was just the first time our team would make history. When I ran for U.S. Senate in 2012, an incredible team of grassroots supporters like you fought alongside me — even as some people wrote us off. You helped me become the first woman elected to the Senate from our state and the first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history. [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70498&L=33597&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvdmlkZW9zL2JpZGVuLWhhcnJpcy1mZW1hLWRpc2FzdGVyLWV4Y2x1c2l2ZS1iaWRlbi1oZWFsdGgtc2NhcmUtc2VjcmV0cy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=84a42489ff713f7ab20786204ac2f8c6883d78a39db1e9be9036d9a85894a4a9]

For four years we’ve watched a diminished Joe Biden play the role of
commander in chief. We’d like to know what his top lieutenants have
been thinking about his mental capacity.

We filed a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70498&L=33582&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLTI1dGgtYW1lbmRtZW50LWNvbXBsYWludC0wMjc2NC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=5fb86e7eaab264ab17ec712faf9f29f21900828d11568f1ac548dad989f21869]
against the Department of Justice seeking access to the documents
related to invoking the 25th Amendment against President Joe Biden
(_Judicial Watch v. U.S. Department of Justice_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70498&L=33582&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLTI1dGgtYW1lbmRtZW50LWNvbXBsYWludC0wMjc2NC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=5fb86e7eaab264ab17ec712faf9f29f21900828d11568f1ac548dad989f21869]
(No. 1:24-cv-02764)).

On August 7, 2024, we submitted a FOIA request for:

> Records and communications of the below listed Department of Justice
> employees, including emails, email chains, email attachments, text
> messages, calendar invites, calendar meetings, correspondence,
> briefings, letters, memoranda, reports, notes, opinions, regarding
> invoking the 25th Amendment against President Joseph Biden.

* Merrick Garland, Attorney General
* Lisa O. Monaco, Deputy Attorney General
* Benjamin C. Mizer, Associate Attorney General
* Acting Associate Attorney General
* Christopher Fonzone, Assistant Attorney General
* Robert Hur, Special Counsel

On February 5, 2024, Special Counsel Robert Hur issued the “Report
of the Special Counsel on the Investigation into Unauthorized Removal,
Retention, and Disclosure of Classified Documents Discovered at
Locations Including the Penn Biden Center and the Delaware Private
Residence of President Joseph R. Biden, Jr.”

In the report, Hur called Biden a “well-meaning, elderly man with a
poor memory” and declined to charge Biden with a “serious
felony:”

> We have also considered that, at trial, Mr. Biden would likely
> present himself to a jury, as he did during our interview of him, as
> a sympathetic, well-meaning, elderly man with a poor memory. Based
> on our direct interactions with and observations of him, he is
> someone for whom many jurors will want to identify reasonable doubt.

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA
body:
We’re not going to make it through the day without your support |
---
[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=a1e636afce484107ae7db970bbee87e2&_e=TQo5kH_25VhO_h-s1iJnubv8AEybIokIPzkrGW8PdMm0mejIJKH5OrSsv45rT1ds8pX1-wklORCWK14HJ9EcHjHa-IIOIFztXJz_diFeVZrLvInIvEbCDLWbjNT4EJOpTToU33hK7IYYtONAMT8NRAQO387IO-gOvmrM74ioMSzj3TEs3F464n_U35qtIM_ZlzTIlr_5e-eLQONpQA28rquesbAnBy0hZQs9ZIlgkQAdCCQo3lQG1L_MOhs-X6LsnACJW_JQYIwgZl7TgBpw272atTctfNhfYbjkZVaWJ5ePS3ABYC6jRlpbpfIcpXOcFslVR8splJNq-QBbvNSMpA-Px4qHneG3jNZzZOhS1AK3ZK1oIUp_N1tK1hsXDAk621VnLBzd-JPLX1uLFKyojnmyBWyBfqY8QobRlHiZldSh98w5LriUqG4aJcOv6uje)

Peter,

While no Democrat presidential nominee has won Montana since 1992, the Montana Senate race, as the Wall Street Journal writes, _**“is national in the sense that the nation is paying attention - as well it should, given that a Sheehy victory would almost certainly mean a Republican Senate.” **_

Peter, I don’t mean to alarm you, but this is a big deal. Since I last wrote to you, my Senate race has become the most expensive in U.S. Senate campaign history.

I’m trying to get that to sink in - I never thought we’d be in this position. Peter, to put things into perspective, there is so much money being spent in this race **[it’s costing us $314+ to reach just one Montana voter.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=a1e636afce484107ae7db970bbee87e2&_e=TQo5kH_25VhO_h-s1iJnubv8AEybIokIPzkrGW8PdMm0mejIJKH5OrSsv45rT1ds8pX1-wklORCWK14HJ9EcHjHa-IIOIFztXJz_diFeVZrLvInIvEbCDLWbjNT4EJOpTToU33hK7IYYtONAMT8NRAQO387IO-gOvmrM74ioMSzj3TEs3F464n_U35qtIM_ZlzTIlr_5e-eLQONpQA28rquesbAnBy0hZQs9ZIlgkQAdCCQo3lQG1L_MOhs-X6LsnACJW_JQYIwgZl7TgBpw20dhX8sc0wUjf7OeLj8mKhUvBv5YOvLx6AAK5OwBQhwzM_GKSehRHbXOaLP5zpEee81j-4BboRs3JY1fLvsqCpOhY0mLVaz8Qg4jHN0NsvO12SRoomvbbOLOI-0QlwGWV9EM5LZkwNaJ70-OIPwUqbOfNeHHzyplPuc0R4SkCoGJ)** If you’re ever curious to know why we’re texting and emailing you daily, that’s why.

My opponent, the _**Wall Street Journal**_ notes, _“has been in close races before and pulled them out. His widest electoral margin in his three Senate victories was less than 4%.”_

Wisconsin had the honor of hosting President Trump -- patriots from all over the Dairy State came together to show their support! **Brown County**
Brown County Republicans came out in full force to show their support for the Trump-Vance ticket at the Team Trump Tour bus stop rally! On September 22, members of the Republican Party of Brown County came together for a Healthy Lifestyle Forum, learning about alternatives to modern healthcare practices. **Calumet County**
The Republican Party of Calumet County hosted an Outpost Rally and were joined by Eric Hovde and Tony Wied! **Door County**
The Republican Party of Door County had a terrific event last night at the Gala in Sturgeon Bay! [#WalkAway](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-mhkhkdy-didthutlhu-ij/) founder Brandon Straka shared his powerful testimony of why he walked away from the Democrat Party and started the Walk Away movement in 2018, and how things have only gotten worse in the Democrat Party since then. **Eau Claire County**
The Republican Party of Eau Claire said a big thank you for their members continued support for President Trump and VP JD Vance! Eau Claire showed up in fashion Tuesday and packed the headquarters to show them Wisconsin is Trump Country! **Green County**
The Green County Republican Party held its first annual** ** Fight for Freedom golf event on Friday, Sept. 27th in New Glarus** ,**with supporting sponsor Erik Olsen for Congress. It was a fantastic day to create awareness and raise additional money for our Victory in November. They were honored to be joined at dinner by Former Gov. Tommy Thompson and RPW Chairman Brian Schimming. **Jackson County**
Jackson County Republicans (and their incredible parade float) showed up in full force to show their support for one of Wisconsin's finest, Derrick Van Orden. **Jefferson County**
The Republican Party of Jefferson County brought plenty of energy and enthusiasm at the Fort Atkinson Trump Car and Truck Parade! **Kenosha County**
The Republican Party of Kenosha County kicked off another Super Saturday! The ground game makes a huge difference in elections. Thank you to Super Saturday volunteers and shout out to Congressman Bryan Steil for providing donuts! **Monroe County**
The Republican Party of Monroe County received lots of positive affirmation at their Trump Rally + parade that started in Tomah and ended in Sparta. Lots of enthusiasm. They are planning to hold this event again in four weeks. **Outagamie County**
Thanks to everyone who stopped by the Republican Party of Outagamie County's Octoberfest booth!! What an amazingly busy and fun day it was. They gave away every single Trump/Vance yard sign they had....looks like it's time to order more for the final month! **Pierce County**
>From Donuts and Coffee to events at their Victory Headquarters, the Republican Party of Pierce County is not slowing down with the election one month away! **Racine County**
More than eighty-five Racine County Republicans came together to watch the Reagan Movie over the weekend! **Richland County**
Richland County Republican Party Headquarters are looking great! **Rock County**
The Republican Party of Rock County has been on a roll with their Super Saturday events! **Rusk County**
The Ladysmith Mardi Gras and Ingram Days Parades were a fun way to promote Republican candidates. Vote for them on August 13th and YES on the two referendums! **Sauk County**
About 200 friends gathered for the Trump Bus Tour in Reedsburg. **St. Croix County**
Rallies and flag waves and birthdays, oh my! The Republican Party of St. Croix County has stayed busy these last two weeks! **Waupaca County**
Waupaca County Republicans made their way out an Outpost Rally and caught these great pictures of two of our amazing candidates! **Washington County**
The Republican Party of Washington County has been non-stop this past month. First, they were joined by Wisconsin's incredible Senator Ron Johnson at their annual fundraiser. They followed that event up with an amazing Day of Action! It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

This means that hear.com’s IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's [hear.com's](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=85f81ed5f7ec45a7a5f2eb706bc9f899&_e=6XliKnYH3IKHDe5EyLF5AtPGvP-qp8_0j7locOUq7vyBMKnHk3JHsr3El5Kj8qKyG7PWATPW9TuRG9No_CbbN0jXeuNl1lZJggRW3wFQYGFtzoCTtOLegXytA6bXCV2_zQQuMYfC9Z0Q5sAIaDwHOzdJfwDKbux1PQ1QLIXw1N7GsrdhGCVLLlvgRFpxJqnKtd9lMVAdv3Yx9Ophrm-ZeOAoI6RTuqpqDXRJ2NI_77ShY0q6MMySAF2FBgcxrCtHknLY1WOfR7dn1vC6rG19NtRDsrpZlPKR4x499XnVYvRpCZFzRhbXcxC4TL2TSOX-v19le9PCxWO5wRQIEVu4F3h9Ww-xzzgIQsTadUdbxx0MiAoLj6y5bwQ7cElELGu_g9aP1D6gZu9QcUFRl1gdH3fS0YNGEM32A4OT7XG0DN-N43E4oTDjsuYynhMfveiqfsq9WBBI2psAeYCJ0PmzlfB1VSda7m55HVPaZOoSSuI%3D) **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **[hear.com's](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=85f81ed5f7ec45a7a5f2eb706bc9f899&_e=6XliKnYH3IKHDe5EyLF5AtPGvP-qp8_0j7locOUq7vyBMKnHk3JHsr3El5Kj8qKyG7PWATPW9TuRG9No_CbbN0jXeuNl1lZJggRW3wFQYGFtzoCTtOLegXytA6bXCV2_zQQuMYfC9Z0Q5sAIaDwHOzdJfwDKbux1PQ1QLIXw1N7GsrdhGCVLLlvgRFpxJqnKtd9lMVAdv3Yx9Ophrm-ZeOAoI6RTuqpqDXRJ2NI_77ShY0q6MMySAF2FBgcxrCtHknLY1WOfR7dn1vC6rG19NtRDsrpZlPKR4x499XnVYvRpCZFzRhbXcxC4TL2TSOX-v19le9PCxWO5wRQIEVu4F7X4IdcfQGiiDOc44r8tIg7ay6F62e05hehou2xhOOxGxYJDX1d_bc1oQYsNtl1LiC3quj47g-ebhROfcV2LJKaDrTDFJ7B5n6Gjsbwmk7_1B6YSkI1QBY2RnSEIi5exDfCSi4w-PJYFqguxPzBkGmI%3D) IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[ Check if you qualify ](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=85f81ed5f7ec45a7a5f2eb706bc9f899&_e=6XliKnYH3IKHDe5EyLF5AtPGvP-qp8_0j7locOUq7vyBMKnHk3JHsr3El5Kj8qKyG7PWATPW9TuRG9No_CbbN0jXeuNl1lZJggRW3wFQYGFtzoCTtOLegXytA6bXCV2_zQQuMYfC9Z0Q5sAIaDwHOzdJfwDKbux1PQ1QLIXw1N7GsrdhGCVLLlvgRFpxJqnKtd9lMVAdv3Yx9Ophrm-ZeOAoI6RTuqpqDXRJ2NI_77ShY0q6MMySAF2FBgcxrCtHknLY1WOfR7dn1vC6rG19NtRDsrpZlPKR4x499XnVYvRpCZFzRhbXcxC4TL2TSOX-v19le9PCxWO5wRQIEVu4F_JHBcniLENNnRz5pI3XLa4UBbMh3d8YNC_8jO4paBnEO-WCQg74jiQd2S4qyxhx_716PK5r9KDV3rgi-YTi3yZ3pydsBksCrZo2uKxz6qxYtxZ81ZSTouQH7W40Q0aLe-KIIXBMAuXov6R8FItzuLU%3D)

What makes [hear.com's](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=85f81ed5f7ec45a7a5f2eb706bc9f899&_e=6XliKnYH3IKHDe5EyLF5AtPGvP-qp8_0j7locOUq7vyBMKnHk3JHsr3El5Kj8qKyG7PWATPW9TuRG9No_CbbN0jXeuNl1lZJggRW3wFQYGFtzoCTtOLegXytA6bXCV2_zQQuMYfC9Z0Q5sAIaDwHOzdJfwDKbux1PQ1QLIXw1N7GsrdhGCVLLlvgRFpxJqnKtd9lMVAdv3Yx9Ophrm-ZeOAoI6RTuqpqDXRJ2NI_77ShY0q6MMySAF2FBgcxrCtHknLY1WOfR7dn1vC6rG19NtRDsrpZlPKR4x499XnVYvRpCZFzRhbXcxC4TL2TSOX-v19le9PCxWO5wRQIEVu4F21VXLqxMqWtxiETjOyficNj3r6C4A2GpZbBQB-msmR0rkcscRdfZUdGxbw4VcjJAXyBrI4jb7del5UmoRuelNChMXxQBAianYoN50CC8zGzHZbM_sA4MDYcaIduz-xK-i0DWnZ-P0Wr4reOrGwYjCE%3D) IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that [hear.com's](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=85f81ed5f7ec45a7a5f2eb706bc9f899&_e=6XliKnYH3IKHDe5EyLF5AtPGvP-qp8_0j7locOUq7vyBMKnHk3JHsr3El5Kj8qKyG7PWATPW9TuRG9No_CbbN0jXeuNl1lZJggRW3wFQYGFtzoCTtOLegXytA6bXCV2_zQQuMYfC9Z0Q5sAIaDwHOzdJfwDKbux1PQ1QLIXw1N7GsrdhGCVLLlvgRFpxJqnKtd9lMVAdv3Yx9Ophrm-ZeOAoI6RTuqpqDXRJ2NI_77ShY0q6MMySAF2FBgcxrCtHknLY1WOfR7dn1vC6rG19NtRDsrpZlPKR4x499XnVYvRpCZFzRhbXcxC4TL2TSOX-v19le9PCxWO5wRQIEVu4F7XatdjORlZ2GhKKv0PokdXVnek1m55fM4NI9670swkgusI7UfroRKplfU1fyLhpB3GPAoaniF0pLpi1g33ajcKAt-07o6klYnkcewzjqC8V6cuRTM3BikEk2oCk5yevjApMbZyHaEt4bSr_yz53rcY%3D) IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains [hear.com's](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=85f81ed5f7ec45a7a5f2eb706bc9f899&_e=6XliKnYH3IKHDe5EyLF5AtPGvP-qp8_0j7locOUq7vyBMKnHk3JHsr3El5Kj8qKyG7PWATPW9TuRG9No_CbbN0jXeuNl1lZJggRW3wFQYGFtzoCTtOLegXytA6bXCV2_zQQuMYfC9Z0Q5sAIaDwHOzdJfwDKbux1PQ1QLIXw1N7GsrdhGCVLLlvgRFpxJqnKtd9lMVAdv3Yx9Ophrm-ZeOAoI6RTuqpqDXRJ2NI_77ShY0q6MMySAF2FBgcxrCtHknLY1WOfR7dn1vC6rG19NtRDsrpZlPKR4x499XnVYvRpCZFzRhbXcxC4TL2TSOX-v19le9PCxWO5wRQIEVu4F7fFUFaYoRFmNtVH1WVoL2M_7PBhiW8Jy4zjesIET0GjH0OlnoeZjKYxJo27qZQJlkq-Xw9XBIBRd9VJXggudLUCiQBEW_26c5b9Yeiha7gDg8UlggXCA5zinmeWcKX_bZHt9OhZvFqyy0FBKjy5Ie4%3D) founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

Trey Taylor, the youngest African American star in Country Western history, is not only a sensation from Nashville but an absolute patriot. He looked over the candidates running for office across the US and picked 10 conservatives that he wanted to help push across the finish line on November 5th.
It is exciting that Trey recognizes Peter Hernandez's potential to represent California in Congress. Limited tickets are available for his TAKE BACK OUR COUNTRY afternoon concert on October 19th in Gilroy. All tickets include a catered buffet lunch and sponsor tickets also include a post-concert intimate gathering with Trey Taylor and Peter Hernandez.

## Albuquerque Balloon Fiesta Begins
Balloon Fiesta, [the oldest and largest](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuwyAQQL8Gb1hwgHEGhnbwlq4dLWIf8VXERHC11b-vmr3703vS-7zO10iZ9vtHfGDgVOa4MB04ayWdBPs-224NCRHQdBi0h1Eb78B0W3DeJedx8VabBMvFaIVWD8Po0-JXN3QUQIHVSjmt1GigTxewJq3Rgld2GKOwClfiUvuvQjtvmPJPObD2S3l0OWzMzybMm4BJwHSeZ89bpZyp8R8hYOIaD8wCpj0ylV3AdMPGcissI1V5izmXssuEjemIuUnaJW8ov1tXw_o8X7LBC6vuj0j51eV_NhwBfgMAAP__EP1gYg) hot air balloon festival held annually in Albuquerque, New Mexico, begins its nine-day run today with balloon launches, drone light shows, skydiving, and chainsaw carving. ## Texas Interconnection to Connect to Southeast
The U.S. Department of Energy has approved a $360 million project to [connect a Texas power grid](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O8yAQAJ8Gd1iw_MUFxde4y9deaXHs2kYixsIoJG9_uvRXjzQjzdd9uYeU07H9Dw_y7bWWJcSWnrRIwQ0HvegB_bfASQ7kpYObVMKCGnYfzU0FB1aDQVQEsOKEKhIGtOicG5IHAVoKYaQwVtnRWieCNJMlq1dlNNOCMLVSx7ZTo1e41vwuT6pjLI8h-72182LqH4OZwdx7H-Ney_FLGcwH9YvBHGpLMROD-WPgVGNp_CydKt9qQk4H1e3N5XSTGiYznvs5VI9nTzmnyzqmxfYIKX-i7Y8HTw8_AQAA___60l5x), known as the Texas Interconnection, to the broader U.S. power grid via a 320-mile line. ## World's Largest Locomotive in Houston
Big Boy, the world's largest steam locomotive, [arrived in Houston yesterday](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z7FugzAQgOGnsTcj32EfZPDQhS1dOyIHzmDJ4Ag7IXn7qlXX7p_06_-6jlcfU9yXT7-xq6-QRz_V-OQRtLIKzWjk7G56voBkBx320GrCVq6uJ54YoA-2YxOILF78xB2AAW1tP8noUKMBrS1oSy01RJ32YC_EZEJrjTCa51jz0dSVK798Cemdn3w0U95kcmut9yLaD4GDwOE8zybkF9KaH6Xm_QcJHHY-i8DhFhd1y29VKvtN8b7EnVXNj0P9cXm4-X7GlGKhThi9bD6m31D95_vp8DsAAP__WK5bBw) and will stay for the weekend as part of its Heartland of America Tour. The train will be on display for three days, make several whistle stops, and exit the state on October 13. Between the last 50-or-so years I’ve spent bringing our past to life in film, and the present stakes facing our fragile, 248-year-old experiment this fall, I can safely say from experience that the 2024 election will go down in history.
From _The Civil War_ to _The Central Park Five_ , _The Dust Bowl_ or _Defying the Nazis_ — in these moments, we had to decide whether or not we'd live up to the essential promise of our nation: a democracy that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.

Patriot,

It's simple.

We cannot fix Washington without independent, common sense leaders who bring
people together.

I'm running for Senate because Washington is broken, and I'm ready to get
right to work with bipartisan, common sense solutions to finally fix the mess.

But with my race in a deadlock, and Marylanders already beginning to cast
their votes, pulling off a victory will require all hands on deck.

Can I count on your support?
<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/urgent-request-email-2-oct-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20241005_urgent-request-email-2_aafd_acs&amtposition=2>

DONATE
<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/urgent-request-email-2-oct-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20241005_urgent-request-email-2_aafd_acs&amtposition=2>
Extreme partisanship and inaction have held us back for too long. Many
Washington politicians simply choose to argue with each other instead of
getting anything done for the people.

With your help, we can send a loud and clear message to all the politicians
in Washington that will be heard all across America this November.

Please consider chipping in your most generous contribution to my campaign
today. Anything you can give makes an important difference right now.
<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/urgent-request-email-2-oct-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20241005_urgent-request-email-2_aafd_acs&amtposition=2>

This is a grassroots movement, and we rely on people like you to fuel our
campaign.

Thank you,
Gov. Larry Hogan
DONATE
<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/urgent-request-email-2-oct-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20241005_urgent-request-email-2_aafd_acs&amtposition=2>

A Personal Message from Governor Larry Hogan:

<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/bio-footer-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20241005_urgent-request-email-2_aafd_acs&amtposition=2>
Hi, it’s Governor Larry Hogan.

When I launched my campaign for the U.S. Senate, I did so with a deep resolve
to maintain the leadership style and principles that guided me during my eight
years as governor.

Fifty years ago, my father, Maryland Congressman Larry Hogan Sr. made a tough
decision. He became the first Republican to come out for the impeachment of
President Nixon. He put aside party politics and his own personal
considerations and stepped up to do the right thing for Maryland and the nation.

Today, Washington is completely broken because that kind of leadership and
willingness to put country over party has become far too rare. But it’s not in
my nature to sit back and watch the dysfunction continue without doing what I
can to roll up my sleeves and get to work.

I’m under no illusion this will be an easy road. But I’m no stranger to
uphill battles, and I know I can’t do it without your support.

I don't aspire to be a United States senator. I don’t need a title and I
don’t need a job, but I’m more concerned than ever about the direction of the
country and I have become more convinced that I can make a difference by taking
the approach and style of leadership I had during my eight years as governor to
Washington.

It’s no surprise this mindset has made me a target of the Washington
partisans. Despite early polls showing a lead, I know I’m the underdog in this
race. And that’s why your support TODAY is so crucial.

So if you can chip in a donation of $25 or more, it will go a long way in
helping me continue building a strong campaign.
<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/bio-footer-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20241005_urgent-request-email-2_aafd_acs&amtposition=2>

For eight years, we proved that the toxic politics that divide our nation
didn’t need to divide our state, and we got results! Let’s get back to work
again and send a message to Washington that will be heard loud and clear across
the country!
Will you join me today and help end the dysfunction in Washington?
<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/bio-footer-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20241005_urgent-request-email-2_aafd_acs&amtposition=2>
Thank you,
Larry Hogan

I finally get to tell you the exciting news, friend: **I'm heading out on my first bus tour in the lead-up to Election Day! I'm fired up to travel across Ohio, talk to voters in their hometowns, and get them excited to vote! **
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94310246/503179802/-1893289703?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk2468-bu-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZWZiNmQzOC0xNjgzLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_iLCL2Wz4cVH_lhkB03O8JLBeftpwJLwoUSnHAEHTWE=)
Talking to voters – whether it's at a rally, on their front porches, or at a union hall – is the most important investment we can make in this final sprint to Election Day. Because I care about running a campaign _for the people_.

name: Douglas Carswell
subject: How we are building a movement for change in Mississippi!
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/msla-11573186?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend, **MCPP has been effective at driving change in Mississippi. **

**We helped spearhead efforts earlier this year to reform school funding, so that Mississippi funds students, not a system.** In 2022, we worked hand-in-glove with lawmakers to cut the state income tax to a flat 4 percent. Before that, a bill we were behind helped deregulate the local labor market.
---
|
---
_Gov Tate Reeves signing into law a bill to deregulate the local labor market._
| **Given that Mississippi has such a large conservative majority, surely it ought to be possible to accomplish far more? **

Tennessee, north of us, has eliminated their income tax entirely. Arkansas and Alabama on either side now have universal school choice. Even Louisiana has managed to pass legislation to give families control over their child’s share of the education budget.

**MCPP has excellent relations with key policy makers. But sometimes driving change means more than being on texting terms with local lawmakers.** It’s not enough to simply spend time at the Capitol. We need to build a mass movement for change, as well.
---
|
---
_Senator Wicker, Speaker White & State Auditor Shad White at recent MCPP events_
| **In politics, nothing moves without a push. **And often the key to pushing policies forward is having a media climate and a culture that demands change.

**The old media might be a shadow of its former self, but MCPP is building a movement for change using new methods of communication.**

This newsletter you are reading, for example, was sent out to over 83,000 people (overwhelming in Mississippi) today – as it is every week.

Since the summer, when we revamped our studio, we have begun to produce a lot more video content.

**__In the past 90 days, we have had 163,793 people watching our YouTube channel, watching 24,267 hours of our content.__**

Here is a sample of some of the content we have produced. **It is an eclectic mix, ranging from Shad White to School Choice, income tax abolition to Islamism – but it is, we hope you agree, of interest to a Mississippi audience. **The viewing metrics we have certainly suggest it is!

Click on the image below to have a look!
---
| [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=2a4fde50d6&e=5703353baa)
---
| As we start to build a mass audience across our state, the case for change becomes harder to resist!

Have a wonderful weekend – and I hope you don’t spend too much of it on YouTube!
---
| [Forward this email to a friend!](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=98b30827b5&e=5703353baa "Forward this email to a friend!")
---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO
---
|
---

Mississippi Center for Public Policy520 George StJackson, MS 39202-3013

body:
We want you to think back to the morning of November 9, 2016.
---
Please don’t click away from this email. We want you to think back to the morning of November 9, 2016. Think back to the way you felt knowing Donald Trump was going to be the next president of the United States -- and that he'd have a Republican House and Senate. Remember the disbelief we all felt and the fear of what was to come ahead? We can't go back. The truth is that we’re running out of time to make sure what happened in 2016 doesn’t happen again. With early voting underway across the country, it’s crucial that we have the resources we need to reach voters in must-win states. And the DNC is the organization best positioned to move those resources where they are needed, when they are needed in this last month before Election Day. **That’s where you come in, Derek. Our work is sustained by donations from lots and lots of people like you, who care deeply about the outcome of this election and understand its stakes.** We are exactly one month away from Election Day, and if you have been waiting for the right time to make your first donation to the DNC, we're asking you to make today that day. Y’all, if you’d told me when I was starting my first job as a special education teacher that one day I’d be writing an email to you as the _Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate from Tennessee_ , I’d have laughed you outta the room. My folks didn’t talk much about politics growing up. In fact, they were Republicans. But they showed me what it means to care about your community. They helped out kids in need — and they inspired me to do the same. I went into special education to help level the playing field. Each and every one of our kids deserves the support to reach their full potential. I am so proud of the work I did in our schools. But I know that there’s more to do. There are so many critical issues that need our attention. I’m someone who has had an abortion, and now I’m furious at the far-right radicals who are taking away women’s right to make our own medical decisions. While working in education for nearly three decades, I saw firsthand the impact of gun violence in schools. And in my own family, we had people suffer because they couldn’t afford healthcare before the Affordable Care Act. **As Tennessee’s next Senator, I’ll fight _every single day_ to restore women’s reproductive rights, keep our communities safe from gun violence, improve healthcare access and affordability, and more. I’m ready to do the work.** **_[I just need your help to defeat my well-funded opponent and the entrenched GOP establishment on November 5th. clean_body: I’m ready — but I need you with me. | Y’all, if you’d told me when I was starting my first job as a special education teacher that one day I’d be writing an email to you as the Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate from Tennessee , I’d have laughed you outta the room. My folks didn’t talk much about politics growing up. In fact, they were Republicans. But they showed me what it means to care about your community. They helped out kids in need — and they inspired me to do the same. I went into special education to help level the playing field. Each and every one of our kids deserves the support to reach their full potential. I am so proud of the work I did in our schools. But I know that there’s more to do. There are so many critical issues that need our attention. I’m someone who has had an abortion, and now I’m furious at the far-right radicals who are taking away women’s right to make our own medical decisions. While working in education for nearly three decades, I saw firsthand the impact of gun violence in schools. And in my own family, we had people suffer because they couldn’t afford healthcare before the Affordable Care Act. As Tennessee’s next Senator, I’ll fight every single day to restore women’s reproductive rights, keep our communities safe from gun violence, improve healthcare access and affordability, and more. I’m ready to do the work. = | = Thank you, Gloria Johnson = | = Gloria Johnson is running for the U.S. Senate because Tennesseans deserve leaders who care. For too long, elected officials like Marsha Blackburn have done absolutely nothing to make Tennesseans’ lives better. The only interests they’ve cared about are special interests. The only people they’ve championed are their donors. Gloria will advocate for real solutions to protect our communities from gun violence, make health care more affordable and accessible for all of us, secure access to the ballot box, and defend reproductive rights. | = = Follow along: | | ---|---|--- Paid for by Gloria for Tennessee Contributions or gifts to Gloria for Tennessee are not tax deductible. | Friend,

name: Rob Mercuri
subject: Navy SEAL & Law Enforcement Endorsements for Mercuri, Early Voting Underway
body:
Early voting has begun.

|
---
**Lawmaker and Law Enforcement Endorsements Grow Momentum** This week, I was proud to announce that I received the endorsement of the Fraternal Order of Police Fort Pitt Lodge #1. Amid out-of-control crime and slashed police budgets, Western Pennsylvanians can count on me to support our brave law enforcement officers and Back The Blue. In Congress, I will always support our courageous men and women in uniform and ensure that they have the tools, support, and resources to effectively do their jobs and keep our communities safe. I am incredibly grateful for the support of the Fraternal Order of Police Fort Pitt Lodge #1 in my bid to bring new leadership and common sense to Washington. Additionally, I was proud to accept the endorsement of former Navy SEAL, Rep. Ryan Zinke (R-MT). In Congress, Rep. Zinke is fighting for our pro-growth agenda, and as a fellow veteran, understands the need to have a strong, national defense while embracing a “peace through strength” approach. [](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=H532jDkpdMHX7rWq3Epj8IXu6GnUa3xLbAy5tPhAi10SyAL9n6TwoJ-3n5lruJ6IvJVto-4zTTp7lU8oRryiFQ&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_05_24_email_to_supporters&n=1) I look forward to working alongside him in Congress as we fight to restore our country and ensure our values are represented in Washington. I was also honored to welcome House Majority Whip Tom Emmer to Pittsburgh last week and thankful for his help as we worked to finish this latest quarter on a strong note. Whip Emmer has been a tireless fighter for the House Republican agenda, and I look forward to working with him in Congress to lower inflation, secure our border, and ensure prosperity for all! Please check out Whip Emmer’s thoughts following our fundraiser: [](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=QfIZV-WGX1tv8x-Rj8_8rmPIALQoB_HtQ9yBvm3EsdcJzrc7rVOoDrcE2R4tt1N3&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_05_24_email_to_supporters&n=2) These endorsements reflect the growing momentum of our campaign and mirror the desire from across PA-17 to see common sense leadership returned to Washington. **Early Voting Is Underway, How to Find Your Polling Place** With early voting officially underway in PA-17, it’s imperative that we continue to encourage voters to bank their vote early and avoid the wait until Election Day! To find out more about how to apply for a mail-in ballot, fill it out, and return it in time, please visit [https://www.pa.gov/en/agencies/vote/voter-support/mail-in-and-absentee-ballot.html](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=lvC0zySgANn09obiz0UGcERadoCJMnx4lvjd6hWYm23JJIaJVq4OiF7UA8BAGDB6hkHTIN7hHJuZw7gKG8dpLZfHE6IeSMQloGoFzyqHMSr-6YeNgLKe-Bqs-QQZ6msG&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_05_24_email_to_supporters&n=3). If voting in-person is your preferred method, that certainly is a great option as well. To learn what polling place to visit, please visit [https://www.pavoterservices.pa.gov/Pages/PollingPlaceInfo.aspx](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=0UzDwLU8EkLkfWPFCr_6rpN-Mqzsq_qkR4BxqH_V_c6BhwCCa-YWkJ43I0mkav0PJ6sv4gMHmUP657Hk6VesUA&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_05_24_email_to_supporters&n=4). **The Work Isn’t Finished Yet** Throughout this campaign cycle, we have been blessed with the incredible financial support of thousands of people, some old friends and some we have met during this journey. Because of this generosity, we were just able to complete our strongest fundraising quarter yet! However, with only one month to go until the election, the campaign is putting every dollar to use almost as quickly as it comes in. Can you [chip in $5, $10, $25, $50, $100](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=flBDtqPbDiWRlxBXWwXH-QmKshK3no_4UipNukJhZ99RDhsiM_AR4u1oRxwyteWjGKMDFyYj98-cMSyXV0pVxw&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_05_24_email_to_supporters&n=5) today to help continue spreading our positive message on the airwaves and building up our grassroots operation even more? I am beyond grateful for your support, and I look forward to winning this crucial election with you in November! Leading us forward, Rob Mercuri[](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/?e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_05_24_email_to_supporters&n=6) | [](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=flBDtqPbDiWRlxBXWwXH-QmKshK3no_4UipNukJhZ99RDhsiM_AR4u1oRxwyteWjGKMDFyYj98-cMSyXV0pVxw&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_05_24_email_to_supporters&n=7 "DONATE TODAY") [DONATE TODAY](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=flBDtqPbDiWRlxBXWwXH-QmKshK3no_4UipNukJhZ99RDhsiM_AR4u1oRxwyteWjGKMDFyYj98-cMSyXV0pVxw&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_05_24_email_to_supporters&n=7)

Dear Peter-
I can hardly believe it. There are only 30 days until Election Day.

Elizabeth Warren and all down the ballot.
Kamala Harris has given us our marching orders. We need to fight for this country we love, fight for the ideals we cherish and live up to the privilege and pride of being an American.
Now is the time to get out there and finish the job. Your passion, commitment and love
of commonwealth and country are going to see us through. How will you contribute to this fight and make sure we run through the tape on Election Day?

name: Christina Bohannan
subject: Election Day is exactly one month away
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Christina Bohannan for Congress
body:
What this final stretch means to me.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94326925/503223312/177624347?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ODE0ZTIxOS0yMjgzLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HOk_xkOiuQ94F4K7n1nSEdaL_xNM9Zoszc_55X0bpSY=)

Peter,

I know your inbox is probably overflowing with fundraising emails as we approach Election Day... which is exactly one month from today! But I wanted to take a moment to speak to you directly about why I'm reaching out.

This campaign isn't just about winning this election. It's about fighting for the place we call home. It's about ensuring that Iowa's 1st District has a representative who truly understands and fights for our needs and rights.

If you've donated in the past, I want to express my heartfelt gratitude. Your support means the world to me and my team.

Friend,

Let's be real here: Floridians know all too well what creepy is.

**It's Rick Scott. He's a creep. **

It's creepy how intent he is on controlling women's bodily autonomy and reproductive choices. He has pushed time and again for a national abortion ban, and would lead the charge in getting such legislation signed into law if Donald Trump gets reelected to the White House.
It's creepy how he voted against the Right to IVF Act, which would have guaranteed federal protections for the procedure. And it's creepy how he _lied about that vote_ — spending millions of dollars on an ad buy saying he would protect access to that very procedure a day after he voted to do the opposite!
The U.S. Senate is one of our world's greatest democratic bodies. It's not a place for creeps and liars, particularly those like Rick Scott intent on pushing the GOP's radical Project 2025 agenda.
**We can and must defeat him: Last time around, Rick Scott spent $64 million of his own money to buy Florida's Senate seat — and he _barely scraped by_ , winning by just over 10,000 votes.**

Look, I'm building coalitions that are much larger than 10,000 votes, and right now, I'm statistically tied with Rick Scott in the polls. But I can't cut my campaign a check for $64 million, nor would I if I could. This is a people-powered movement, and it's _your_ support I need to defeat Rick Scott.

Peter,

In case you missed it, here's the bottom line up front.

✔ I joined Mark Levin on _Life, Liberty & Levin_ recently to discuss the state of the race in Pennsylvania, the #1 swing state in the nation.

**✔ Pennsylvania is Mark Levin 's home state. As he said, he takes this race _very personally and wants to win this Senate seat._**

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=55a0a5b76d27444ca3e141164fab4a70&_e=FqyjWZgHv4BaEPcSujpjR8JTO0Bu-uQHSCh00OHkKkR2c8P3zpR62qO6vjblBUObWBjS468db8UP7t-x82iewZ9i7F0keUTBhu-OjDOyR1sWN1vY0Gp6VL-shzhbwyyE5QApGMIdZOIRxHf75WpjcBL0osWqF_t3wDLC5PUeHbH3bnTr3Cek-ltOTlH-KPqOWJlxm-QWpwyzUTHSrtF8-iTh5-jtqsaiDXn-1uWGuyzuJTfW8fTNjeCYH1Xr4rRhEgCCxgaEm_onC1U3cxQRaiQwDPWxgBvGxtkK106OtvL4ZvMvnCAKxXy-H04uS99_5eFsnRlskhgN5nnuMwsl-nVOquItyYcZfmO22OxPLDshxbxUNabkaoGXJFC4zvkRUjYYyIabtBkSlf27pz3tEw%3D%3D)
**[WATCH DAVE ON _LIFE, LIBERTY & LEVIN_](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=55a0a5b76d27444ca3e141164fab4a70&_e=FqyjWZgHv4BaEPcSujpjR8JTO0Bu-uQHSCh00OHkKkR2c8P3zpR62qO6vjblBUObWBjS468db8UP7t-x82iewZ9i7F0keUTBhu-OjDOyR1sWN1vY0Gp6VL-shzhbwyyE5QApGMIdZOIRxHf75WpjcBL0osWqF_t3wDLC5PUeHbH3bnTr3Cek-ltOTlH-KPqOWJlxm-QWpwyzUTHSrtF8-iTh5-jtqsaiDXn-1uWGuyx3b3-rY1btHetFlzhqVGhZ8VV1fqybuiA6ccO1guBaEyfAZqA4o2uZXsLiysFxR31qF_OHpKtaqEQQdcO4wN7tvQMUlJleqj6t7SnZLUbaD24VeYor9T5erzuGKmYGwtfBl1RIfEmr7JlDl0i8p3EGyYswWKQG34UEQexuJOn2CA%3D%3D)**
Mark and I discussed a number of issues, from the situation in the Middle East, to the crisis at the border, and the urgent need to defeat Kamala Harris and Bob Casey, who have shown complete weakness on every issue that is impacting us.

**It 's not hyperbole to say this is the most consequential election of our lives.** All eyes are on Pennsylvania as the top swing state and I'm running in the #1 battleground race that _WILL decide the Senate majority and control of the White House._

As a combat veteran, I've been on tough missions. But if I'm going to win my next mission to defeat a Democrat who's spent 18 years in DC & flip the Senate to GOP control, I'm going to need your support.

**The fight isn’t over, and I’m counting on you to help push us across the finish line.[Can you rush a contribution of $10, $25, or whatever you can right now to help us finish strong?](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=55a0a5b76d27444ca3e141164fab4a70&_e=FqyjWZgHv4BaEPcSujpjR8JTO0Bu-uQHSCh00OHkKkR2c8P3zpR62qO6vjblBUObWBjS468db8UP7t-x82iewZ9i7F0keUTBhu-OjDOyR1sWN1vY0Gp6VL-shzhbwyyE5QApGMIdZOIRxHf75WpjcBL0osWqF_t3wDLC5PUeHbH3bnTr3Cek-ltOTlH-KPqOWJlxm-QWpwyzUTHSrtF8-iTh5-jtqsaiDXn-1uWGuyzdU2N1SBP47ONfkGQ2qGh9BOdF5t8Iwpf35orT94W6iqotdosluexCcckEosOyuTi9GTqZu1gr0Caa_QoEBc8UeeINqXz2iyWXXbOIBUKwDmT4ltrrPp84g_KPtJTcgGAIIfBY6nv8ekFp3M0NpHiFmzGphtMAbFrPSm-ihuppxw%3D%3D)**

**_The time to pitch in to help us win this race is NOW.

Voters are making their final decisions. Ballots have been mailed to Pennsylvanians in a number of counties and voters are voting early in person._**

It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this _**[could make a donation of any amount](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=55a0a5b76d27444ca3e141164fab4a70&_e=FqyjWZgHv4BaEPcSujpjR8JTO0Bu-uQHSCh00OHkKkR2c8P3zpR62qO6vjblBUObWBjS468db8UP7t-x82iewZ9i7F0keUTBhu-OjDOyR1sWN1vY0Gp6VL-shzhbwyyE5QApGMIdZOIRxHf75WpjcBL0osWqF_t3wDLC5PUeHbH3bnTr3Cek-ltOTlH-KPqOWJlxm-QWpwyzUTHSrtF8-iTh5-jtqsaiDXn-1uWGuyx0L15vA-mQLzDIAyG8OAlWWj4OPV0avvI7v5jBgI7zQ5L3iWSQ0YqMxdvf018ZSxoLJuj77Dht89frz_PCATxP-FuxhNFe5GeNOG22ZCnMO0RehxHu1yLy6aJFzXuV6NlJ78S3Vz2tKI7d1BPSQm0nOsqKFk5iFuxxUIGEObYZ2g%3D%3D)**_ to show the strength of our movement during this critical fight for Pennsylvania and our great nation's future.

I know how to restore strong leadership in our country because I've done it before. And I'll do it as your next Senator.

Thanks for your support,
_Dave McCormick_

You can’t spoil what’s already rotten

| | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/)
---
Peter, A few days ago we sent you an email about a despicable attack on Jill by the corporate controlled mainstream media and we wanted to make sure you didn't miss it. On a MSNBC segment of “Morning Joe” with Newsweek editor Tom Rogers on Monday, Tom and the hosts threw out all the tired old lines about Jill being a “spoiler” for the Democrats. It was even more extreme than usual, as they insisted that without the Green Party, Democrats would have won every single presidential election since 1992 and that there was literally no other reason to run outside the duopoly of war and Wall Street other than playing the role of a so-called spoiler.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ads?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=resend_msnbc&n=1)
---
Who exactly is Tom Rogers anyway? Tom Rogers is a wealthy media mogul. As the first President of NBC Cable, he created MSNBC. Yes, the same Tom Rogers who is demanding that Americans bully their neighbors into voting for Kamala or they’re responsible for “electing Donald Trump” is one of the pioneers of the transition to partisan news monopolies that serve as mouthpieces for the duopoly.

Here’s a little known fact about the origins of the term “spoiler” – it first raised its ugly head when the pro-slavery Whigs used it to attack anti-slavery candidates! That’s how long the powers that be have been fighting against democracy and human progress.

We know that votes are not owned, they’re earned. And Kamala Harris mostly seems interested in earning votes from right-wing Republicans. For one thing, she refuses to consider an arms embargo against Israel, even as they widen their genocidal war against their neighbors, increasing the danger of WWIII. The Democrats claim she’s “working tirelessly for a ceasefire” but those claims ring hollow as billions upon billions of dollars and weapons keep flowing to Israel after almost a year of genocide. On issue after issue, from fracking to immigration to the death penalty, Harris and the Democrats have lunged to the right to appeal to the likes of Dick Cheney.

Rather than reflect upon the impact Harris’ pro-corporate, warmongering positions could have on the election, Tom Rogers and the Morning Joe crew would rather fear-monger over Jill and Butch for daring to run as candidates for people, planet, and peace. We’ve seen this from the start – from lawfare against our ballot access to delaying our federal matching funds, to unleashing their attack dogs on Jill and Butch every chance they get. Stein/Ware is challenging empire, and the empire is lashing out.

Jill and Butch are the only anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate emergency campaign for voters across the nation. That’s why the anti-Democratic Party resorts to lies and smear campaigns – because they know that Stein/Ware represents the values of so many Americans who are tired of war abroad and corporate oligarchy at home.[_**

Peter, we have just over 30 days to amplify Jill and Butch’s vision of people, planet and peace to voters everywhere. Can you dig deep today to make sure that we can defy the cynical mouthpieces of the establishment and get the message out to millions of voters that they can vote their values with Stein/Ware on November 5th?**_](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ads?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=resend_msnbc&n=2)

name: Evangelicals for Harris
subject: Pray. Vote. Share.
body:
Voting Our Christian Values | |
---
| | | Our votes are a witness to our faith. That’s why our votes for Harris and Walz matter so much, because they embody our Christian values of loving our neighbor and having compassion for the vulnerable among us.

Many of our states have now started early voting and many of our friends and neighbors are now deciding for whom to cast ballots. **This election is very close and we need to give Harris and Walz a decisive national win,** So, we prayerfully encourage and invite you to:
**PRAY**. Please pray for our candidates, country, and for all of our friends and neighbors who are considering their votes for Harris and Walz. **Pray for strength and courage for all of us as we cast our votes for Harris and Walz.**

**VOTE**. **[Make your plan to vote](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=eac13d6cfd&e=43463f1dee).** Make sure you’re [registered to vote, find your polling place, and see what’s on your ballot](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=6b97a7af66&e=43463f1dee). If you’re able to, **vote early. **

**SHARE**. As Christians, we understand the importance of sharing our witness. **_Share your decision to vote for Harris and Walz with at least five others._ **You might share on social media, host a **[house party with friends and neighbors to discuss issues of concern](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=946e4339f0&e=43463f1dee)** , and put up a yard sign. These simple, effective ways of sharing your vote amplify the impact of your witness. **Are you interested in [doing more with Evangelicals for Harris](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=532acb2302&e=43463f1dee)?** Please let us know of your interest [here](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=862895835c&e=43463f1dee). We’re especially looking for evangelical Christians in **Michigan, Wisconsin, Pennsylvania, Georgia, North Carolina, Arizona, Nevada, New Mexico, and Nebraska**. Let us know if you’d like to learn more or know of someone who might be by [signing up here](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=16ba4c0efc&e=43463f1dee).

If we all do our part, we will elect Harris and Walz as our next President and Vice President.

**_For where two or three have gathered together in My name, I am there in their midst._** (Matthew 18:20)

Thank you for journeying with us during this most important election season of our lifetimes. We’re praying for you.

Blessings,
The Evangelicals for Harris Team

subject: Today I am asking for your $10 to support GIFFORDS PAC and my campaign. Together, we will build a brighter future for our nation.

body:
Let’s turn the page on Donald Trump and his extremist Republican allies as we elect leaders that will keep our communities safe.
#

In 31 days, we face the most important election of our lives, and probably one of the most important in the life of our nation.
There is so much at stake this election, including making reasonable gun safety laws a reality in America. Let me be clear: We need universal background checks. We need red flag laws. And we need an assault weapons ban.
**I know that we must end this senseless epidemic of gun violence in our country once and for all._The same cannot be said about my opponent._**
[**That is why I am asking you to step up and join our movement for common-sense gun violence prevention policies today. Folks, in exactly one month, America faces its most consequential election in my lifetime.
Our next chapter is not yet written. Nothing about the 2024 elections are a foregone conclusion — not winning here in Virginia, not holding onto our Democratic Senate majority, and not sending Kamala Harris to the White House.
What we do during this month and on November 5th will have a lasting impact on our nation.
Right now, will you donate to my re-election campaign to help keep Virginia in the blue column? Our average donation this month is $29 — some folks give less, some give more, but whatever you can give would mean a lot. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
If you know me, you know I’m an optimist — so I truly believe that not just Democrats, but the VAST majority of Americans believe in our founding ideals, trust our democratic systems, and want to live in a country that brings people together instead of pushing them apart.
But optimism alone won’t get the job done.
We can either stand up against the forces that seek to tear down our democracy, or we can sit around and let them win.
If you’re with me and ready to win, I hope you’ll consider donating $29 or whatever amount is meaningful to you to help us reach out to undecided voters in these final critical weeks. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]

| | | Friend, it's Martin Sheen. There's somebody I want to tell you about.

He's a two-term governor running with Kamala Harris on the top of the ticket, a joyful warrior who eloquently and unapologetically represents Democratic values, and a loving father -- someone you can easily imagine lending you a hand around the house or, yes, even calling a hotline on Thanksgiving for turkey advice.

And no, I'm not talking about Jed Bartlet, my character on _The West Wing_. **I'm talking about Governor Tim Walz, our vice presidential nominee.** [**I know he and Vice President Harris will do a lot of good for our country, especially if folks like you and I do our part by pitching in $5 (matched to $15) to make sure they have a Democratic Senate majority to work with.**](https://go.dscc.org/go/20044?amount=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20241005-MartinSheen-BartletWalzComparison-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20241005-MartinSheen-BartletWalzComparison-Pros-sl1&akid=17945%2E9716520%2ErqjTP6)

Why is your donation _today_ so important? Think about what we've accomplished together over the past four years: We've created millions of jobs, invested in American infrastructure, taken action on climate change, and so much more. **Our Democratic Senate majority has been a critical part of that progress.**

And after four years of digging out from Donald Trump's mistakes, we've all been reminded how important it is to have authenticity in the White House. President Biden has tirelessly worked to grow our middle class, and so has Vice President Harris. Based on his time leading Minnesota, I can tell you Governor Walz is cut from the same cloth.

**But building on our accomplishments requires electing genuine, hard-working leaders to more than just the White House.** It's also about having like-minded people in Congress who will push progress forward. Securing a Democratic Senate is absolutely crucial to continuing our work into 2025 and beyond.

**A Democratic Senate won't just appear out of thin air, though. We have to work for it. So, to help the Harris-Walz ticket make progress, I'm personally asking:**

Lincoln was 25 when he was first elected to the IL House.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20241005&t=1&akid=1263%2E587540%2EnAj0Gw)
Peter, this dude was elected at 25 years old. Recognize him? 🎩
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241005?refcode=em20241005&amount=5&refcode2=1263_587540_nAj0Gw&akid=1263%2E587540%2EnAj0Gw)
I know the media will never give President Biden the credit he deserves but I just have to say the history student in me is still geeking out.
He faced unprecedented challenges – from the largest economic downturn since the depression to the largest pandemic since the Spanish flu. In three years, he not only got kids back in school, but got our economy on track growing faster than any of the G7 with the one of the lowest rates of inflation by far. (It was still high but far less than most countries.)
At the same time he passed the largest climate spending ever of any country in human history, brought chip manufacturing back to the US, added Finland and Sweden to NATO, created the first Office of Gun Violence Prevention ever that oversaw a 20% reduction in gun homicides in Q1 2024, passed the first federal gun law in 30 years that has stopped well over 800 high risk people from buying semi automatic rifles like the AR-15, put billions into school and community safety programs, and so much more.
**I think the number one reason Biden was able to do this (besides incredible staff) was because he was first elected to the Senate when he was 29 and had over 50 years experience on the Hill by the time he became President.**
Time and time again we see the sooner someone starts in elected office and the more experience they get the better the president they are:
* FDR was 28 when first elected in NY.
* LBJ was 28 when he was elected to Congress.
* Lincoln was 25 when he was first elected to the IL House.

That’s why I’m so excited to see what comes from the young candidates Leaders We Deserve endorses. All of them are generational leaders under 35 and all of them need your help to get their start in the critical races they are campaigning in RIGHT NOW.

# Melton for Iowa 2024
---
---
| Hello Peter,

This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc.
Where I went on the campaign trail last week: Last week, I attended Nishna Productions' legislative forum on disability care in Red Oak, chatted with the Iowa Democratic Party's Rural Caucus, did a number of interviews with news outlets, attended the Humboldt Co Women's meeting in Livermore, attended the Emmet Co Dems monthly meeting in Estherville, had my Coffee with the Candidate event in Nevada, attended a gathering with the Marshall Co Dems in Marshalltown, spoke with the Pocahontas Co Dems in Pocahontas, spoke with the Carroll Co Dems in Manning, met with the Kossuth Co Dems in Algona, and capped my week with a speech at the Fall BBQ event with the Webster City Dems in Webster City.
The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: I apologize for getting this newsletter out late this week, but it's been quite busy on the campaign trail. I'll keep this one short and sweet. Just wanted to let you know that I taped my appearance on PBS's Iowa Press yesterday (Friday), and people seem to think it went well. This is the setting I would have debated my opponent Randy Feenstra in, but he declined. I'll share that link in the media links section below. Also, we're working on a final push of radio and streaming ads along with a text campaign to 150k contacts sharing the news of our Virgil endorsement to Independents and Republicans in the district, so if you can chip in to help us fund that final push, I'd be grateful. 30 days to go! I like our momentum!
Our schedule for this week: Much of this week has been spent on campaign logistics, getting ready for our final 30 day push on the radio, digital, streaming, and texting front. I've also been doing a lot of interviews with various media outlets. One month. One month until Election Day 2024. Yet Early Voting will begin earlier — and some voters are casting ballots as we speak. The polls are close. I understand that this could feel scary for you. The stakes of this election are scary. The future of abortion rights, the Supreme Court, and our democracy will be decided. But right now, I’m choosing hope over fear. In 2020, Americans showed up in record-shattering numbers — even in the middle of a pandemic — to vote out Donald Trump. Joe Biden and Kamala Harris won more votes than any ticket in history. In the 2022 midterms, experts kept saying that we were in for a “red wave.” They kept insisting that Democrats had no chance to win. But we expanded our Democratic Senate majority, and we defeated downballot election deniers. And every time abortion rights have been left up to voters in the two years since Roe v. Wade was overturned, abortion rights have won. Every single time. Not by a little bit, not by a squeaker, but by a big margin. We can win in 2024 too. We can elect Kamala Harris, stop Trump’s Project 2025 plan from being realized, pass national abortion protections and so much more. But none of this is guaranteed. You don’t get what you don’t fight for — and now is the time to raise our voices, to act, to fight. [**If you’re able, will you split a donation between the Harris-Walz campaign and our re-election so we can do everything we possibly can in the next month to hold our Senate majority, defeat Donald Trump, defend our democracy and protect our freedoms?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2763?t=8&akid=2363%2E4032634%2EuE0-Wy)

Fellow Patriot, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Fellow Patriot, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? Hi, it’s Sen. Brad Pfaff. I don’t usually reach out on Saturdays but:
We’ve officially crossed the threshold, Friend—Election Day is only 30 days out.
From the very beginning, my public service career has centered itself on prioritizing small farmers and working Wisconsinites.
Advocating for workers and underdogs doesn’t end in 2024—it’s an ongoing fight that I want to continue in 2025 and beyond. But I need your help to accomplish that, Friend.
As we enter the last 4 weeks of this campaign, staying on track with our fundraising deadlines and goals will help us maximize the impact of every single day. We absolutely cannot afford to take our foot off the gas when the finish line is in sight, Friend.
With just one month left, your support means more than you can imagine. Can I count on you to make a grassroots contribution today and help our campaign stay on track to defeat my far–right challenger? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pfaff-email?refcode=20241005_em_fr_b1_BP_NGP]

name: John Fetterman
subject: We did it, and we can do it again
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
A blue Senate is not possible without the re-election of the Frontline Five, and they all need your help right now.
#
**We f*cking did it, Derek!**
Last month, I set a goal to raise $150,000 for the Frontline Five by the end of the third quarter and this team CRUSHED that goal. Together we raised critical funds for five of my fellow Senators who are battling it out in tough races to keep the Senate blue.
In case you forgot, the GOP is spending millions of dollars to unseat five of my colleagues (Jon Tester, Bob Casey, Jacky Rosen, Tammy Baldwin, and Sherrod Brown) and return the majority to the far-right MAGA Republicans.
They are hoping to flip seats in Nevada, Montana, Wisconsin, Ohio, and my home state, Pennsylvania. And with those wins, Republicans plan to take back control of the U.S. Senate. **Not on my watch.**
Derek, I refuse to believe that we will lose the Senate this year. 🙅♂️
With just about 30 days to go until Election Day, we need to commit to leaving no stone unturned in electing the Frontline Five and securing our Democratic majority in the Senate.
**That’s why: I am setting another goal to raise $180,000 for the Frontline Five by midnight on Election Day.** Deep down, I know this team is capable of pulling this off. Our combined support will provide the much-needed resources to fight off attacks from the GOP and its super PACs.
**[Derek, will you rush a $5 contribution to the Frontline Five and get us one step closer to keeping a blue Senate? We have just about 30 days to raise $30,000 and every donation counts!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-fff-20241005?refcode=em20241005-9446&refcode2=9446_434096_UXhJ3u&akid=9446%2E434096%2EUXhJ3u)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-fff-20241005?amount=5&refcode=em20241005-9446&refcode2=9446_434096_UXhJ3u&akid=9446%2E434096%2EUXhJ3u)**
I don’t have to tell you how much is at stake in this election. Keeping a blue Senate is paramount to delivering on the issues that matter most to Americans:
✅ Securing access to abortion
✅ Codifying LGBTQ+ rights
✅ Passing the voting rights act
✅ Voting through liberal SCOTUS nominations
✅ Approving Kamala Harris’ Cabinet picks
✅ and so much more...
None of this is possible if we lose the Senate in November. Every donation you make to a **Fetterman’s Frontline Five** email will have a direct impact on each of the five key Senate races needed to defend our Senate Majority.
**[So, I have to ask, Derek: will you take action RIGHT NOW to help defend the Frontline Five and our Democratic Senate Majority with a $5 contribution right now?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-fff-20241005?refcode=em20241005-9446&refcode2=9446_434096_UXhJ3u&akid=9446%2E434096%2EUXhJ3u)**

This election is too important to sit on the sidelines. I hope you’ll join me in supporting my Frontline Five and defending our majority ahead of one of the most consequential elections of our time.
💙 John
John Fetterman
U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania

_* Sent in support of Elissa Slotkin for Michigan and Lucas Kunce for Missouri *_
Peter –
You may have heard about Mitch McConnell's $22.5 million investment to defeat us in Michigan, but I wanted to weigh in personally about what this means for our race.
First and foremost, I've heard from a number of people that maybe they think we're going to win this race because this is Michigan and Democrats win in Michigan.
Um, no.
Michigan is a swing state, full stop. And just because it's swung to Democrats in the last election or two, it can swing right back. It was not too long ago that Trump won here once before – by just 10,704 votes.
And if you need further evidence of that - look at the McConnell super PAC buy to beat us.
Mitch McConnell is many things, but he is no fool. He is not going to take $22.5 million and light it on fire. He could spend that in a lot of other places, but he chose to spend it to defeat me.
And that's because they think they can win here.
He's right.
They can win here.
Mike Rogers could win.
But that will not happen if we have the resources to respond to this McConnell ad buy.
That's why I am turning to you. Because emails like this are a single greatest source of fundraising for our campaign at this point.

body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

INSIDER NEWS FROM THE FRONTLINES OF THE POLITICAL REVOLUTION

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

HEADLINES: 2024 Homestretch Kick Off | Ilhan Omar on Tim Walz | John
Nichols: Bold Economic Vision | Swing State Survey Results | CA Rent
Control | Chicago School Board | Denver Worker Rights | New Endorsements |
Phonebank Week | & MORE!

★ ★ ★

With just ONE MONTH to Election Day, Our Revolution’s GOTV operation is in
full force in the swing states to defeat Trump once and for all. [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19251?t=1011&akid=6950%2E5885482%2EAIF43L ]Chip
in to help us make 5 million voter contacts into the 7 battleground
states.

Ilhan Omar joined Our Revolution and thousands of progressives tuning in
LIVE from around the country to kick off the final Homestretch of the 2024
Election.

Ilhan knows how crucial grassroots GOTV work is in a turnout election —
and how important it is to reach voters who may face language barriers or
need extra help getting to the polls. She also knows the stakes of this
election.

“In Minnesota we made transformative legislation with Tim Walz as
Governor, and I know that’s possible for us as progressives to have that
level of co-governance with him if he becomes the VP of this country,”
Ilhan said.

Also on the [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/20088?t=1012&akid=6950%2E5885482%2EAIF43L ]Live Call, we released Our Revolution’s Swing State Survey
results (see below) and drilled down on exciting down ballot fights for
housing, union rights, climate, education, and more.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19251?t=1013&akid=6950%2E5885482%2EAIF43L ]Donate any amount to help ramp up our on-the-ground organizing in the
battleground states and beyond. We’re on a mission to beat Trump and elect
more progressives at every level.

★ ★ ★

Writer John Nichols of The Nation joined our discussion, sharing his
insights on the state of the race after traveling the swing states.

John said voters are hungry for a clear vision for economic renewal, and
that the Harris/Walz ticket needs to do better in rural areas than both
Hillary and Biden did in order to win.

“For young voters or disenchanted voters, there’s an intersection between
raising wages, access to unions, restoring manufacturing, and saving the
planet. They need to hear that 21st Century vision,” he said.

★ ★ ★

SURVEY RESULTS

From our survey of more than 1,400 Our Revolution supporters in the 7
swing states, we’re seeing some worrying signs of a motivation gap among
progressives.

One in four told us they know progressives who aren’t planning to vote for
Harris — and four out of five think Harris providing more policy details
would help sway voters in their swing state.

We know that celebrity endorsements won’t be enough — it will take
voter-to-voter outreach to make up the tight margins in states like
Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, and Michigan.

Unfortunately, our organizers and survey-takers are reporting an influx of
grassroots Trump canvassers and door-knockers — and the majority say
they’re seeing more Trump signs than Harris signs in their neighborhoods.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19766?t=1014&akid=6950%2E5885482%2EAIF43L ]WE HAVE A LOT OF WORK TO DO

★ ★ ★

The polls are razor thin, and Our Revolution is carrying out a massive
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19766?t=1015&akid=6950%2E5885482%2EAIF43L ]Swing State Operation to make 5 million voter contacts into the key
battleground states — Arizona, Georgia, Michigan, North Carolina, Nevada,
Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin.

Biden/Harris narrowly beat Trump by less than 300,000 votes in these
states four years ago, and 2024 will be a turnout election — whichever
side runs the most effective voter mobilization will prevail.

Our Revolution organizers like William and Jessica are hitting the streets
in the 7 swing states that will decide the 2024 presidential election.

Not only are we knocking doors and setting up events for direct voter
outreach — our national team is mounting a massive phonebank operation.
(p.s. Can you spot our GOTV kitty in the picture above?)

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19766?t=1016&akid=6950%2E5885482%2EAIF43L ]We must maximize the next 30 days to Nov. 5th. Please pitch in any
amount to power our Swing State Strategy — there’s no time to waste.

★ ★ ★

For those who can’t donate, we hope you’ll consider volunteering for a
shift with our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19809?t=1017&akid=6950%2E5885482%2EAIF43L ]Swing State Phone Bank — which kicked off this week with
thousands of calls into Pennsylvania and Arizona.

This is the best way for progressives to make an impact from anywhere in
the country, and have fun while we’re at it! This is how we run up the
margins where it matters most.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19809?t=1018&akid=6950%2E5885482%2EAIF43L ]SIGN UP HERE

★ ★ ★

★ ★ ★

To illustrate just how powerful the grassroots can be, look no further
than the victory of Dave Upthegrove for WA State Public Lands Commissioner
— a key seat for climate and the environment.

Our Revolution made 300,000 voter contacts into the state ahead of
election day, then helped chase down ballots to beat Big Timber’s
hand-picked candidates by just 49 votes — out of more than 2 million votes
cast!

“The takeaway is simple. Every vote matters,” Dave told us on the Live
Call Monday night. “Timber put $1.2 million behind our opponent and we won
by running a grassroots campaign. Our Revolution’s work matters, keep it
up!”

With his background in conservation, Dave will protect the forests, work
to prevent forest fires, and grow local economies. And he will be the
first openly gay statewide executive in state history!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16898?t=1019&akid=6950%2E5885482%2EAIF43L ]Chip in to help us scale up this kind of work to beat Trump and the far
right, while electing more progressives like Dave up and down the ballot.

★ ★ ★

Chicago Teachers Union President Stacy Davis Gates joined our Live Call
and laid out our plan to elect a progressive school board in Chicago.

For the FIRST time ever, Chicago voters will be able to elect their school
board members — and Our Revolution is supporting CTU’s powerful slate of
10 progressives on the ballot.

“We have expanded democracy in the city of Chicago,” Stacy told us. “It’s
an amazing feat, and it only happened because we organized AND we voted
AND we went on Strike.. and and and..” Our diverse movement is fighting on
every terrain — and that’s how we win.

★ ★ ★

NEW ENDORSEMENTS

“For the people, not the powerful.” That’s the rallying cry of the
campaign of Dean Preston for San Francisco Supervisor (D-5) — who has the
support of both Our Revolution and Bernie Sanders.

Our powerhouse slate in Northern California also includes Kate Harrison
for Mayor of Berkeley, Vinnie Bacon for Mayor of Fremont, Carroll Fife for
Oakland City Council (D-3), Jackie Fielder for SF Supervisor (D-9), and
Lynda Deschambault for East Bay Parks District (Ward 2).

These are candidates who have a record of championing the issues that
directly impact the bottom line of moneyed interests — from taxing the
rich to protecting tenants rights. Let’s get them into office!

★ ★ ★

★ ★ ★

Housing has rightfully become a top national issue this election season.
We’re proud to be part of the coalition fighting for direct policy change
in California that could be replicated in other states.

Michael Weinstein of Justice for Renters joined our Live Call Monday to
rally for Prop 33 — the ballot measure for CA Rent Control which would
also allow local communities to stop predatory corporate landlords from
charging unfair rent.

“The rent is too damn high,” Michael said. “California is the poorest
state by standard of living. Billionaire corporate landlords are sucking
this country dry. They’re using algorithms to squeeze the last bit of
money out of tenants.”

“Solving the housing affordability crisis requires a variety of
approaches, but it starts with the rent,” he said. This is why Our
Revolution is calling, texting, emailing, and having conversations with
Californians to vote Yes on Prop 33.

★ ★ ★

"We’re poised to win worker’s rights at the ballot box in Denver,” CWA
Organizer Katie Romich told our live audience Monday night.

Our Revolution is proudly supporting the Stronger Denver ballot measure
for collective bargaining rights for all public workers — Vote Yes on 2U!

Despite NOT having organizing rights, Denver workers joined together and
built the political power to get collective bargaining on the ballot,
Katie explained. She thanked Our Revolution for mobilizing to make over
50,000 voter contacts to get the Mayor and City Council to stand with
workers.

★ ★ ★

CLIMATE CATASTROPHE

This is climate chaos in action — and one of the deadliest storms in U.S.
history. Our Revolution is joining with Sunrise Movement, Friends of the
Earth, and other great organizations to hold Big Oil accountable for the
horrific damage of storms like Hurricane Helene.

The full scale of devastation is still being calculated, but hundreds of
Americans are dead from Florida northward to Western North Carolina. FEMA
has specifically cited climate change as having made the storm more
dangerous.

Insult to injury — our own tax dollars continue to supercharge disasters
like Helene. Instead of taxpayers pouring $20 billion a year in subsidies
to Big Oil, we should be charging them a tax to clean up their
fossil-fueled disasters.

★ ★ ★

★ ★ ★

Billionaires and corporate cronies are pouring millions into the 2024
election trying to elect Trump AND beat some of our top progressive
champions — but we refuse to be silenced by the donor class.

We must out-organize the Big Money and rightwing extremists with a massive
