Ilhan knows how crucial grassroots GOTV work is in a turnout election — and how important it is to reach voters who may face language barriers or need extra help getting to the polls. She also knows the stakes of this election. “In Minnesota we made transformative legislation with Tim Walz as Governor, and I know that’s possible for us as progressives to have that level of co-governance with him if he becomes the VP of this country,” Ilhan said. Also on the [ ]Live Call, we released Our Revolution’s Swing State Survey results (see below) and drilled down on exciting down ballot fights for housing, union rights, climate, education, and more. [ ]Donate any amount to help ramp up our on-the-ground organizing in the battleground states and beyond. We’re on a mission to beat Trump and elect more progressives at every level. ★ ★ ★ Writer John Nichols of The Nation joined our discussion, sharing his insights on the state of the race after traveling the swing states. John said voters are hungry for a clear vision for economic renewal, and that the Harris/Walz ticket needs to do better in rural areas than both Hillary and Biden did in order to win. “For young voters or disenchanted voters, there’s an intersection between raising wages, access to unions, restoring manufacturing, and saving the planet. They need to hear that 21st Century vision,” he said. ★ ★ ★ SURVEY RESULTS From our survey of more than 1,400 Our Revolution supporters in the 7 swing states, we’re seeing some worrying signs of a motivation gap among progressives. One in four told us they know progressives who aren’t planning to vote for Harris — and four out of five think Harris providing more policy details would help sway voters in their swing state. We know that celebrity endorsements won’t be enough — it will take voter-to-voter outreach to make up the tight margins in states like Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, and Michigan. Unfortunately, our organizers and survey-takers are reporting an influx of grassroots Trump canvassers and door-knockers — and the majority say they’re seeing more Trump signs than Harris signs in their neighborhoods. [ ]WE HAVE A LOT OF WORK TO DO ★ ★ ★ The polls are razor thin, and Our Revolution is carrying out a massive [ ]Swing State Operation to make 5 million voter contacts into the key battleground states — Arizona, Georgia, Michigan, North Carolina, Nevada, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin. Our Revolution organizers like William and Jessica are hitting the streets in the 7 swing states that will decide the 2024 presidential election. [ ]We must maximize the next 30 days to Nov. 5th. [ ]SIGN UP HERE ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ To illustrate just how powerful the grassroots can be, look no further than the victory of Dave Upthegrove for WA State Public Lands Commissioner — a key seat for climate and the environment. Our Revolution made 300,000 voter contacts into the state ahead of election day, then helped chase down ballots to beat Big Timber’s hand-picked candidates by just 49 votes — out of more than 2 million votes cast! “The takeaway is simple. Every vote matters,” Dave told us on the Live Call Monday night. “Timber put $1.2 million behind our opponent and we won by running a grassroots campaign. Our Revolution’s work matters, keep it up!” With his background in conservation, Dave will protect the forests, work to prevent forest fires, and grow local economies. And he will be the first openly gay statewide executive in state history! [ ]Chip in to help us scale up this kind of work to beat Trump and the far right, while electing more progressives like Dave up and down the ballot. ★ ★ ★ Chicago Teachers Union President Stacy Davis Gates joined our Live Call and laid out our plan to elect a progressive school board in Chicago. For the FIRST time ever, Chicago voters will be able to elect their school board members — and Our Revolution is supporting CTU’s powerful slate of 10 progressives on the ballot. “We have expanded democracy in the city of Chicago,” Stacy told us. “It’s an amazing feat, and it only happened because we organized AND we voted AND we went on Strike.. and and and..” Our diverse movement is fighting on every terrain — and that’s how we win. ★ ★ ★ NEW ENDORSEMENTS “For the people, not the powerful.” That’s the rallying cry of the campaign of Dean Preston for San Francisco Supervisor (D-5) — who has the support of both Our Revolution and Bernie Sanders. Our powerhouse slate in Northern California also includes Kate Harrison for Mayor of Berkeley, Vinnie Bacon for Mayor of Fremont, Carroll Fife for Oakland City Council (D-3), Jackie Fielder for SF Supervisor (D-9), and Lynda Deschambault for East Bay Parks District (Ward 2). These are candidates who have a record of championing the issues that directly impact the bottom line of moneyed interests — from taxing the rich to protecting tenants rights. Let’s get them into office! ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ Housing has rightfully become a top national issue this election season. We’re proud to be part of the coalition fighting for direct policy change in California that could be replicated in other states. It’s going to be decided by — at most — a few hundred thousand people in a handful of battleground states.

This year, we’re doing the same.
Over the last four years pouring resources into data — we’ve built a list of Veterans and members of Military Families that we need to target over the next month to win the election. Tailored and targeted. We’re messaging to them in ways no other organization can, because we message differently than any other organization.
Veteran to Veteran. That’s the secret. Credible messengers with impactful messages.
We’ve spent heavily targeting these audiences already, and in the home stretch we are moving more budget into television and digital advertising than we ever have.

name: Rashida Tlaib
subject: Re: We shouldn't have to beg our own government to help its own citizens.
body:
We deserve representatives who save lives at home and abroad. | | |
---
Friend, This week, my team and I have been yelling and crying and begging our own government to save the American families who’ve been abandoned in Lebanon amidst horrific Israeli bombing that has targeted civilians and medical centers, destroying neighborhoods and killing children with American-made “bunker buster” bombs. **We’ve received heartbreaking calls from 148 Americans with ties to our congressional district who are desperate for help evacuating Lebanon and haven’t received enough support from the U.S. State Department.** Instead of listening to the majority of Americans who want us to stop arming Israel, the Biden administration continues to send bombs and billions of our tax dollars to kill children—while supporting Israel’s indiscriminate bombing of civilians in Lebanon and its new ground invasion of Lebanon. **As a proud Arab American and Muslim woman serving in Congress amidst systemic erasure and dehumanization of Arab and Muslim communities, I know that we deserve better from our government.** We deserve representatives who understand that saving lives at home and abroad are interconnected, and who aren’t afraid to speak out against U.S.-facilitated war crimes. **We need more people in public office who push our government to invest in life and in everyday people’s needs, rather than death and endless war.** We deserve elected officials who will stand up for our rights—including our right to protest and free speech. As MAGA billionaires are spending hundreds of millions of dollars to interfere in our elections and drown out our voices, anti-war candidates need our grassroots support. I created the Rooted in Community Leadership PAC to help elect progressive candidates who understand their neighbors’ struggles and will always put their communities’ needs first. [**Can you donate today to help elect candidates who will defend our rights and save lives at home and abroad? We’re nearing a year of U.S.-backed war crimes against Palestinians, and now the Biden administration is enabling a wider regional war.
In the past two weeks, Israel’s attacks have killed over 1,300 people in Lebanon, including 90 children. After displacing 2 million people in Gaza without facing any consequences, Israel’s government has now displaced over 1 million people in Lebanon. The Israeli military is using the same tactics in Lebanon as in Palestine, leveling entire neighborhoods with “bunker buster” bombs, destroying roads and other civilian infrastructure like medical centers, and killing doctors and rescue workers.
My congressional district is home to one of the largest and most vibrant Lebanese communities in the United States. **For over a week my team and I have been responding to heartbreaking calls, supporting 148 American families with ties to our district in their desperate attempts to evacuate from Lebanon.**
A new mom of a 5-month-old is trying to get her child an emergency passport. A veteran broke down in tears asking, _“Do my two purple hearts mean anything to my country?”_ Already a father of four from Dearborn Michigan was killed by Israeli bombs. Family after family is saying: Please don’t leave us here and please stop bombing us.
**We shouldn't have to beg our own government to help its own citizens.** The mission of the U.S. State Department is to protect Americans, and they are failing. Our government knew this was coming and had no plan to get Americans out.
Meanwhile, millions of Americans in six states are dealing with the devastation of Hurricane Helene, with more than 200 people dead, entire towns and roads and bridges wiped away, and thousands still stranded without necessities like water or food. As the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) announced it needs $9 billion to adequately support hurricane recovery efforts last week, the Israeli military announced on the same day that it got an $8.7 billion aid package from the U.S. government.
**We deserve better from our government. Instead of wasting trillions of our tax dollars on war, our government should fund what communities need here.**
We deserve representatives who understand that saving lives at home and abroad is interconnected. **We deserve public officials who see all of us as human beings who deserve to live** , including Muslim Americans and Arab Americans who’ve experienced a frightening rise in violent hate crimes.
I created the Rooted in Community Leadership PAC to counter the money from fossil fuel CEOs, the weapons industry, and MAGA billionaires who are trying to uphold the unjust status quo by interfering in our elections. We need to support grassroots candidates for public office who care deeply about their constituents and push to invest in our communities at home rather than endless military funding.

Fellow American,

In 2006, my opponent, Jon Tester, beat the then-Republican incumbent senator by just **3,562 votes.**

| Widespread problems with the mail system could disrupt voting.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=3975%2E35263%2Ei8uPoI)
Peter — Ever since Donald Trump appointed him in 2020, Postmaster General Louis DeJoy has done everything he can to make the USPS more expensive and less convenient to use. _It’s a shame._ DeJoy has made massive cuts to postal services, decommissioned mail-sorting machines, and slowed down mail delivery in the months leading up to the 2020 election — when millions of Americans were counting on voting by mail. Not only that, a federal judge even ruled that DeJoy’s harmful policies right before the 2020 elections harmed delivery. _Seems awfully convenient that in a year with record-breaking vote-by-mail, Trump’s hand-picked appointee enacted changes that hurt mail delivery services..._ Now, election officials are warning that widespread problems with the mail system could disrupt voting in this year’s critical elections. **Enough is enough — it’s time for Louis DeJoy to be removed as Postmaster General before he degrades the USPS any further.** **[If you agree, add your name today to Tammy’s petition calling on the USPS Board of Governors to remove DeJoy from office as soon as possible.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/signup/2410_USPS_petition/?refcode=AU_STB_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20241005_PM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=3975%2E35263%2Ei8uPoI)** | | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/signup/2410_USPS_petition/?refcode=AU_STB_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20241005_PM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=3975%2E35263%2Ei8uPoI)

The USPS is a vital service that millions of Americans count on for access to medicine, paychecks, ballots, and so much more — which is why passing legislation in the Senate to improve the USPS has remained a priority for Tammy.
But it’s clear that only new leadership will be enough to overcome Louis DeJoy’s crusade against the critical services the USPS provides.
Thank you for using your voice to bring awareness to this critical issue.
— Team Baldwin

https://ruby4or.com/ [https://ruby4or.com/]
Friend,
There is now one month until the election. In a month, we will go to the ballot box and determine who will represent us in Congress for the next two years.
So far, we’ve built an inspiring grassroots campaign made up of everyday people. I’ve enjoyed this campaign so much, and I’m incredibly proud of what we’ve all done together.
Now, we’re entering the time when all eyes are on us for this election. We only have a month to show that we are the best choice to get to our shared vision of safe, prosperous small towns and rural communities across Oregon.
We know we have better ideas. Voters have been supportive of our ideas to protect women’s rights, secure affordable healthcare for everyone, and create economic opportunities for everyone. To win this election, we need to spread those ideas across Oregon’s second district.
We know that our approach of working hard to create and support new bipartisan programs and policies that will help Oregonians is better than sitting back and voting against them to block progress, alongside a bloc of right-wing extremists.
With a month to go until election day, we don’t have much time left to spread these winning ideas. We need all the help we can get. Can you donate $10, $25, $100, or any other amount to help us spread word of our campaign across this district? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dan-ruby--friends-of-1?refcode=onemonth]

Millions are still struggling to recover from the devastation of Hurricane Helene, with dozens dead, thousands missing, and countless others left without power or access to roads and resources.
One of the states hardest hit by the storm was Georgia. And, in true fashion, Georgia Congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene has a conspiracy theory to explain it—she claims Democrats can control the weather and caused the hurricane.
Yes, really.

As with many right-wing conspiracy theories, the lies about Helene started with Donald Trump. In the days following the storm, Trump falsely accused Democrats of withholding aid from Republicans affected by the disaster. He also spread lies about the federal government’s rescue response in key swing states like North Carolina and Georgia.
**Things only got stranger from there. **
TikTok videos theorized that Helene was engineered to pave the way for lithium mining, and these outlandish claims received hundreds of thousands of views. AI-generated videos even showed Donald Trump wading through floodwaters to assist in the relief efforts—despite being completely fake, they’ve racked up millions of views.
**These lies have now reached Marjorie Taylor Greene, who claims Democrats created the hurricane to somehow influence the election.**
It’s easy to dismiss MTG as a fringe figure, but the truth is she’s one of the most influential voices on the right. Her power comes not _despite_ her belief in these wild conspiracies, but because of it. Her MAGA supporters are drawn to the same lies and misinformation she is.
**Trump sets the stage, and figures like Greene ignite the flames that are destroying our democracy.**
The good news is that we can fight back by doing what COURIER does best: publishing trustworthy local news where the public is most likely to encounter misinformation—on social media and in their email inboxes.
We strengthen our democracy with facts and the truth.

#

Peter, I don’t want to alarm you.
I don’t want to stress you out.
But right now, I’m having trouble seeing a path towards our goals. That’s bad, because these goals aren’t arbitrary. They are what we need to raise to win this race.
[**So — today, right now, before whatever you have planned later this afternoon, before something else comes up, I’m asking you to chip in to my campaign.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241005-2-160&t=1&akid=3270%2E734936%2Ebr1Age)

| | | Hello, As a fellow conservative, you likely already well know and feel the pressure that is being put upon you to abandon your principles by the progressives on the far left. You know that fighting back for what you believe in is the best thing to do. In these trying times, we conservatives must turn to the greatest document in the history of the world to promise freedom and opportunity to its citizens for guidance; **our Constitution.** That’s why I’m writing today. I’d like to offer you the chance to gain **[free access to Heritage’s Guide to the Constitution today to help you defend your principles against those on the far left.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=0e2957f662a14eb3871e463c7b9bd33b&_e=dK36cfVcH16FbwrD7gaTnneEyMcpYnyJnXBK6j2m9Ax0Pgglv1ItEkupt2RSAlyze96nt3624ziN0yP4cQAxNLOLAf-hDQyJYuKacQZZ1Rr_1nKKCO_XLbA_PPdySNWgpA09yNtSh4T6vy_RcdGed7peF6EdJCmmG-WEAZxv2mHZT488VaUNfE7HydNBOWVKTqbyeVgJ4f5XBdBx-pP6hc0xy0W21Is5NrkLQuB_FsMVElBdQzXaH4subYH5CFxpCsHFVOOMkPcqX_xSTHvM2sp6aDRYKTvIqHPE0Je4-hGB_MVPCvflDKj_nQNB1F-bmwLDTi847L8UDx4VCsfU-mhxuVzeNV8rewoasfXHFu4%3D)** [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=0e2957f662a14eb3871e463c7b9bd33b&_e=dK36cfVcH16FbwrD7gaTnneEyMcpYnyJnXBK6j2m9Ax0Pgglv1ItEkupt2RSAlyze96nt3624ziN0yP4cQAxNLOLAf-hDQyJYuKacQZZ1Rr_1nKKCO_XLbA_PPdySNWgpA09yNtSh4T6vy_RcdGed7peF6EdJCmmG-WEAZxv2mHZT488VaUNfE7HydNBOWVKTqbyeVgJ4f5XBdBx-pP6hUNegkVqFCYM8E9SGszsNeP4VBdpPjU8smoej3pk3Sx6knIn3FOrSXvES4m1k-U2IfFhbW_aFlCY_4i_N7GlW3eAA-HAppG8Zo74N2GMLk1NXhhtJ5t_qdy4mtBWRiD1IU6gJUyjAVlssdPw94Ks_K4%3D) In this free digital interactive guide, you'll find:
* **Useful, clause-by-clause analysis** of the entire Constitution and each amendment
* Input from more than **100 constitutional scholars and legal experts** including President Reagan's former Attorney Ed Meese
* **A thorough review** of what the Constitution actually says and how it applies today
* **A copy of the Constitution** and the documents that served as its foundation

This is a critical year in our nation’s history. The country is polarized and divided on a great number of issues, and roughly half of the voting population is being swayed towards greater government control over our lives—they want government-controlled health care, higher taxes and redistribution of wealth in the form of socialism, increased regulations, to do away with the Electoral College, and for open borders. It is for this reason that we need to educate as many people as possible, of all age groups, the freedoms promised to us in the Constitution. Because if we don’t truly understand the freedoms that it promises to us as citizens, then we will not fight to defend those freedoms. To get your free access today and to help us make sure that everyone in the conservative movement has refreshed their understanding of the Constitution this year, will you activate your free access by clicking this link today? If so, please use this link to activate your access to the guide today: **[https://secured.heritage.org/constitution/](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=0e2957f662a14eb3871e463c7b9bd33b&_e=dK36cfVcH16FbwrD7gaTnneEyMcpYnyJnXBK6j2m9Ax0Pgglv1ItEkupt2RSAlyze96nt3624ziN0yP4cQAxNLOLAf-hDQyJYuKacQZZ1Rr_1nKKCO_XLbA_PPdySNWgpA09yNtSh4T6vy_RcdGed7peF6EdJCmmG-WEAZxv2mHZT488VaUNfE7HydNBOWVKTqbyeVgJ4f5XBdBx-pP6hcVQ9FSu6HaEYHpnzWPpz_bu-4FbSACttLWBaDZrD1EQXMXyi5jUXeW9WD1zAcRKGLcdegjPNzIEAb9YerDt22QyWQXiWDzTNn6_ke1FaRAoedCHwvz46K5IaeVNi3ctnTVx_-iNFNrxOFKjx2mE23s%3D)** This resource has been hailed across the nation as an "outstanding Guide," which is why I consider it one of the finest resources Heritage has ever produced. I think you'll enjoy reading it, and I know you'll find use for it each day. With this powerful Guide in hand, you'll be ready to stand up to the far-Left and confidently defend the vision of our Founding Fathers. [**I hope you'll claim your copy today.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=0e2957f662a14eb3871e463c7b9bd33b&_e=dK36cfVcH16FbwrD7gaTnneEyMcpYnyJnXBK6j2m9Ax0Pgglv1ItEkupt2RSAlyze96nt3624ziN0yP4cQAxNLOLAf-hDQyJYuKacQZZ1Rr_1nKKCO_XLbA_PPdySNWgpA09yNtSh4T6vy_RcdGed7peF6EdJCmmG-WEAZxv2mHZT488VaUNfE7HydNBOWVKTqbyeVgJ4f5XBdBx-pP6hTieXAhMLqX_mBALPEv5Rx3sIvL4lkYH96S0k-jUMhlcI42EeLfQLJuQKZmWB7R2XE4wYBJZHIWb5ldCCkUXik25lYJbFqNi8_PTjN6oXqlg7FhTZnPA9cmBPR_TFzp2xB7EcF_TfmZjd7QUfUPWvgg%3D) Thank you, Tony Johnson Director of Membership

Peter, I’m reaching out with a concerning update about my race, so I hope you’ve got a moment. I’ll start with the good news: **New polling shows us with a very narrow lead over my opponent Derrick Van Orden. As of now, I’m up by 1 point.** The bad news is I’m being **absolutely pummeled** on the airwaves with dishonest attack ads. body:
Our campaign is organizing here in Seattle and in swing states across the country!
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20241005-4369-footer&t=1&akid=4369%2E420207%2EhsBshg)
Peter, can you believe Election Day is just one month away?!
Our people-powered movement is organizing here in Seattle _and_ in swing states across the country. We’re knocking on doors, running ads, and doing twice weekly phone banks with the Harris campaign — and we have a lot more voters to reach in these next 31 days!
**To keep up this critical outreach work, we’re setting a goal of raising $2,000 in the next 24 hours.[Will you pitch in $3 or anything you can now to help?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241005-1?refcode=em20241005-1&amount=3&refcode2=4369_420207_hsBshg&akid=4369%2E420207%2EhsBshg)**

There is so much at stake depending on what happens over the next month.
**Donald Trump and his MAGA movement want to conduct mass deportations, ban abortion nationwide, and give more handouts to the richest 1% at the top.**
**But we have an opportunity to stop them, Peter.** In electing Kamala Harris and a Democratic Congress, we won’t just be saying no to the MAGA agenda — we’ll be winning an opportunity to make lasting progressive change on so many fronts.
We’ve passed massive, visionary legislation to improve the lives of people across the country. We’ve shown what can happen when we elect progressive leaders who are willing to fight for the people. Let’s get out there and elect even more so we can protect abortion rights, bring down housing costs, raise the minimum wage, and pass real, humane immigration reform.
We have 31 days to go, and we can’t do it without you, Peter.
[**Will you pitch in $3 or more right now to help us reach our $2,000 24 hour goal and keep organizing to win this election?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241005-1?refcode=em20241005-1&amount=3&refcode2=4369_420207_hsBshg&akid=4369%2E420207%2EhsBshg)

| Peter, I'm running for Governor of Virginia because this race is personal to me. **Let me explain why.**

Growing up, we moved around multiple times for my father’s job, but ultimately, we settled in Virginia. My parents — my father, a veteran and law enforcement officer, and my mother, a nurse — instilled in me a deep devotion to our country and an abiding commitment to service. I attended Henrico County Public Schools and went on to attend the University of Virginia. After graduation, I began my career as a federal law enforcement officer — working on money laundering cases and tracking narcotics traffickers with the U.S. Postal Inspection Service. I then joined the CIA as a case officer, where I worked undercover, collecting intelligence, managing assets, and overseeing high-profile programs to combat terrorism and keep Americans safe.

Let me explain why. Growing up, we moved around multiple times for my father’s job, but ultimately, we settled in Virginia. My parents — my father, a veteran and law enforcement officer, and my mother, a nurse — instilled in me a deep devotion to our country and an abiding commitment to service. I attended Henrico County Public Schools and went on to attend the University of Virginia. After graduation, I began my career as a federal law enforcement officer — working on money laundering cases and tracking narcotics traffickers with the U.S. Postal Inspection Service. I then joined the CIA as a case officer, where I worked undercover, collecting intelligence, managing assets, and overseeing high-profile programs to combat terrorism and keep Americans safe. = In 2014, my husband Adam and I moved back to Henrico County, just miles from where we grew up, to raise our own children. I never thought I would one day run for elected office, but when I saw the division and dysfunction threatening our country after the 2016 election, I knew our country and Virginia’s 7th District deserved better. In Congress, I’ve worked every day to lower prescription drug costs, protect our democracy, support our veterans, defend our rights, and more. But now, Virginia is seeing dangerous and divisive rhetoric take over Richmond and drive extreme policies. I’m running for Governor because I know we can do better – and I’m ready to bring my unwavering dedication to hard work and my commitment to uniting individuals to address the genuine issues affecting our Commonwealth. = | = | = | = | = | = Thank you, Abigail * | | = Paid for by Spanberger for Governor Spanberger for Governor P.O. Peter,
**My name is Debbie Mucarsel-Powell. I’m an immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. And I’m officially running to defeat Sen. Rick Scott and serve as Florida’s next U.S. Senator.**
Rick Scott has failed us in Florida, and I refuse to sit back and watch him push my state and country backward. I’m prepared to fight to protect our rights, our economy, and our very democracy — and even more, I’m prepared to win.
But this race will be one of the most competitive Senate races in 2024, and we’re up against a deep-seated Republican incumbent who spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time around. The only way I can compete — and _win_ — is with the support of grassroots Democrats like you.
**I've set an ambitious goal to raise $25,000 by midnight to defeat Rick Scott, and I need your help to reach it.[Please, will you split a donation between my campaign and Dick Durbin right now to flip Florida blue and expand our Senate majority?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94377908/503294187/1527729052?source=LOC_EM_FR_2024.10.05_DMP-News_B1_F1_S1_C1_Actives_N-T1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNGI3MTYxMi00MzgzLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q4k6T5pPlvdyP4gJZYn1t97G26i1zyG31cIQfxjnIAc=)**

**When I was 14, my mom, my three sisters, and I left our home in Ecuador to find a better life in America.** We lived in a one room apartment. My mom worked double-shifts during the day and took classes at night to learn English. I picked up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help make ends meet.
Those years weren’t easy. But thanks to my mother’s relentless belief in a brighter future for her children, I went on to graduate from college, become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and write the bill to expand Medicare Advantage coverage.
**My story — coming from a one room apartment to walking the halls of Congress — is only possible in America. But Rick Scott has spent his time in Washington doing everything he can to _destroy_ the country that gave my family a shot at a better life.**
Rick Scott has a net worth up to nearly a quarter of a _billion_ dollars, yet he’s proposed tax increases on working families and the middle class. He’s pushed for a nationwide ban on abortions. And he wrote the GOP plan to end the Social Security and Medicare benefits that so many rely on.
**That’s why I’m running to defeat him this November. Experts say that Rick will be one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot — which means that if we build a powerful grassroots team full of people like you, Peter,_we can take him down._**

The only way I can compete — and win — is with the support of grassroots Democrats like you. I've set an ambitious goal to raise $25,000 by midnight to defeat Rick Scott, and I need your help to reach it.= = When I was 14, my mom, my three sisters, and I left our home in Ecuador to find a better life in America. We lived in a one room apartment. My mom worked double-shifts during the day and took classes at night to learn English. I picked up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help make ends meet. Those years weren’t easy. But thanks to my mother’s relentless belief in a brighter future for her children, I went on to graduate from college, become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and write the bill to expand Medicare Advantage coverage. My story — coming from a one room apartment to walking the halls of Congress — is only possible in America. But Rick Scott has spent his time in Washington doing everything he can to destroy the country that gave my family a shot at a better life. Rick Scott has a net worth up to nearly a quarter of a billion dollars, yet he’s proposed tax increases on working families and the middle class. He’s pushed for a nationwide ban on abortions. And he wrote the GOP plan to end the Social Security and Medicare benefits that so many rely on. That’s why I’m running to defeat him this November. Experts say that Rick will be one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot — which means that if we build a powerful grassroots team full of people like you, Peter,we can take him down. So please, I’m personally asking:= If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately and be split between Debbie Mucarsel-Powell and Dick Durbin: ******=**** ******=****** ******=****** ******=****** ******=****** ******=****** Thank you for joining me in this fight for a better Florida and a better future for all of us. body:

You've probably heard Bill Clinton's 1992 presidential campaign slogan, _"It's the Economy, Stupid."_ Clinton's political strategist, James Carville, posted it inside campaign headquarters to keep the team focussed and on the message.

The slogan is making a comeback in 2024 as Republicans highlight Kamala Harris's dismal economic record. But if you're a freedom-loving American, we have a different slogan for you.

**"It's the Senate, Stupid."**

Conservatives are rightly focused on the presidential race this year, but winning the White House – as critical as it is – won't be enough to save the country without a conservative Senate. Without the Senate, President Trump won't be able to confirm his appointees or enact his second-term agenda.
**A Republican president without a conservative Senate is simply a waste of a Republican president.**
**[**That's why we must take action right now to help elect the best Senate candidates across the nation.**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=cd37d87c547f4f78b450bb95f0b60087&_e=cwJKVInEFrmd3RKdhidUuQpJZyT4kkTaAwCwpyacKUcFyWrF7YGxpt77scg6gl1gfbJ1XdeQkWTIufQTkwFUqOLXms-X3V-hJzJ-3IUMZ9D_0Dd-4kjled-dHPp46Cj-Lk082kbEDGG-nbtou1l3GWmg8F0l0PpcesMVT-SXzoHKoQUgLHVFqRtOAzf7aKBk1xuXH2la94nXJCaOkvBYn_ge9PCVd5cppqtpscJLzep95kZ5IYil1mtPdubvtVmUQXAxOiiH-kb82XLO9Sgilw%3D%3D)**
A president can campaign on good policies, but he doesn't write the bills. As long as liberals control the Senate, good legislation will never be signed into law.

_Does anyone think Chuck Schumer will ever send bills to President Trump's desk to secure our borders, grow our economy, expand American energy, and restore election integrity?_ Of course not. If we fail to win the Senate, none of these common-sense policies will be passed. And if Kamala Harris wins, we won't be able to stop Senate Democrats from nuking the filibuster, passing their extreme agenda without debate, and creating a permanent Democrat majority.

****As we head into the final days of this election, we must support the conservatives running for U.S. Senate.**** These eight candidates believe in the principles of freedom that make America great and are willing to fight for them. They aren't liberal RINOs who will sell us out as soon as they're elected.

subject: Josh Hawley voted to stall the PACT Act

body:
Josh Hawley turned his back on veterans like me.
#
Peter — I’m a Marine veteran who was exposed to toxic burn pits in Iraq.
**Josh Hawley turned his back on veterans like me by voting to stall the PACT Act,** legislation that expanded healthcare coverage for those of us who were exposed to these toxic pits. Now I’m running to replace him in the U.S. Senate.
So before I ask you to **[add a donation of any amount to my grassroots campaign,](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/75122?refcode=em20241005-7929&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7929%2E614464%2E-aZ2Tu) please let me share more about why this issue is personal to me and how it has impacted so many of my fellow veterans.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/75122?refcode=em20241005-7929&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7929%2E614464%2E-aZ2Tu)
It was 2009. I was stationed at the Al Taqaddum Airbase where I was a Marine Captain leading a police training team. Twelve Marines and a Navy Corpsman. Running missions through Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Ramadi.
It was my first of three tours of duty during the War on Terror. And from our camp, the base’s burn pit loomed over us.
Smoke columns filled the sky and blew through our living space. We ran through it, joking about how we should be doing gas mask runs. For three months that pit bathed us in toxic fumes. We accepted it and focused on our duty.
For me, that was planning our routes and poring over intel to avoid the immediate danger: IEDs on all the convoys and missions we were running outside the wire. I was so proud to bring every member of that team home safely.
**Or so I thought — because, as it turns out, we couldn’t protect ourselves from our own country.**
When I got back from Iraq, I developed a persistent tickle in my throat. Constant irritation. I never had allergies before and annoyed myself with the constant throat clearing. Eventually, I was so embarrassed by it that I went to the base clinic. They said it was postnasal drip and that they could give me allergy medicine. There was no formal diagnosis. But over 10 years later, it’s still there.
Bothersome. Uncomfortable, but certainly manageable. And that’s about the best story you’ll hear about a vet who’s been exposed to burn pits. Many struggle with chronic respiratory issues. Migraines. Cancer.
So imagine how we all felt, watching all these Republicans like Josh Hawley, most of whom have never even worn the uniform, throw us a giant middle finger by blocking efforts to expand health care for veterans exposed to these toxic burn pits.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/75122?refcode=em20241005-7929&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7929%2E614464%2E-aZ2Tu)
What they did was about as anti-American as it gets. Patriots don’t attack veterans who suffered injuries or illness from being around those toxic pits.
Many of these same Republicans spent years voting to keep us in these forever wars, lying to the American people about what was really going on over there, and getting rich off their defense contractor stocks that skyrocket when we’re at war.
These people profited off of sending us over there only to screw us when we came back messed up. **It’s criminal — and I’m ready to do something about it.**
I served my country for 13 years in the United States Marine Corps. I’d give anything for this country. That’s exactly why I’m running to replace Josh Hawley in the U.S. Senate.
**We deserve leaders who are willing to make even an ounce of the sacrifice our veterans have.[If you’re with me, please add a donation of $10 or anything at all to my grassroots campaign today so we can get this message in front of Missouri voters and defeat Josh Hawley this November.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/75122?refcode=em20241005-7929&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=7929%2E614464%2E-aZ2Tu)**

+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Hi Derek, |
| it’s Jacky Rosen. The story below is a special one about my faith and |
| how I first got involved in politics. This one means a lot to me, so I |
|hope you’ll take a moment to read it. But if you don’t have the time to |
| take a look right now, [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2024_abs_em_rosen.-iRKiy&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20241005_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1004&akid=7830%2E5257348%2E9G1Gy9 ]could you still split |
| $10 or |
| more between me and Adam Schiff to help me keep Nevada and the Senate |
| blue? |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Derek,

My career in public service began in 2016 when I was recruited to flip a
competitive House seat blue. I was serving as the president of Nevada’s
largest synagogue, and looking back now, that was incredibly fitting –
because my Jewish faith and values have always been at the very core of my
work in Congress.

In fact, my decision to run for public office was guided by the Jewish
principle of Tikkun Olam – to leave the world a better place than how we
found it.

I’m so proud of the progress we've made in the years since. And in the
face of growing antisemitism, attacks on reproductive freedom, and threats
to tear down our democracy, I'm as committed as ever to making positive
change happen. But I need your help.

Right now, polls are showing me locked in a dead heat with my
Trump-endorsed opponent – who just set a major GOP fundraising record in
the race that will likely decide Senate control. So please, I'm humbly
asking:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2024_abs_em_rosen.-iRKiy&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20241005_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1005&akid=7830%2E5257348%2E9G1Gy9 ]If you're with me in the fight to continue making progress for the
people and communities we love, will you split
$10 or
more between Adam Schiff and me to help defend my seat in Nevada and keep

We’re heading into the last month of this campaign, and I couldn’t be prouder of everything that we’ve accomplished, Peter.

**We’ve made incredible headway meeting with Mississippians in all 82 counties, many of whom I’ve had the pleasure of meeting while on the trail for my 800-mile advocacy run.**

Peter, we’re so close to Election Day – _just one month out! _**That’s why our campaign is on overdrive to turn out every single Democratic voter in our district.**

_Here’s what’s on our to-do list:_
* Pass out our Harris/Walz + Mark Takano yard signs across the district 🪧
* Hire last minute canvassers to knock on doors 📖
* Fund our proven-effective digital ads and campaign mail 📬
* And so many other odds and ends!

But Peter, with a far-right MAGA opponent, Mark and I need your help to fund these campaign operations to make sure we win on Nov 5th and flip crucial House seats across California.

Peter -- Today, President Donald J. Trump will be making his return to Butler, Pennsylvania \- He will stand in the same spot where he nearly lost his life on July 13th. Trump will be speaking at 4:00 pm CT today and [you can go to this link](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=MRuMgJCAUDeQvfKMPFefr3xkOh7mlVV7wJcT6EtEAHzWeByIn8-eXRnbOSx8QePv6zyRAPf8Fgr4ak_hHS_UXg&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_president_trump_returns_to_b&n=2)[ to be able to watch it live](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=MRuMgJCAUDeQvfKMPFefr3xkOh7mlVV7wJcT6EtEAHzWeByIn8-eXRnbOSx8QePv6zyRAPf8Fgr4ak_hHS_UXg&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_president_trump_returns_to_b&n=3). Let’s make the number of viewers skyrocket watching his speech from there as President Trump plans to honor the memory of Corey Comperatore, a firefighter who died while shielding his family from the bullets. Comperatore’s wife, daughters and sisters will be on hand Saturday. Trump also plans to recognize the two other victims injured in the assassination attempt, David Dutch and James Copenhaver, as well as thank his personal Secret Service detail for surrounding him on stage. We’ll be tuning in and hope you do as well. We will remember the lives lost and those injured in this violent attack. \- OKGOP Team

body:
Arizona simply does not have blowout elections, and Kari Lake lost her last race by less than 1% of all votes cast. If we’re going to defeat her this time we need to hit these goals.
#

Peter, we’re sorry to bother you on a Saturday evening.
We’re sure you’ve got better things to do.
But Ruben Gallego’s fundraising is running into an absolutely crippling slowdown right now.
We set a 50,000 donation goal ahead of Wednesday, October 9th. That’s an important date for three reasons:
1. It is the day that Ruben is going to debate Kari Lake.
2. It is the day that early voting begins in Arizona.
3. It is the day that mail-in ballots start getting sent out to voters.

We won’t beat around the bush — we’re way behind on that goal. So far behind that we’re not sure how we’ll get there.
But the reality here is that this race is far closer than the polls show. Arizona simply does not have blowout elections, and Kari Lake lost her last race by less than 1% of all votes cast. If we’re going to defeat her this time we need to hit these goals.

The battle for the Senate is in high gear and the outcome will have major implications for our nation irrespective who wins the White House. Here's an update on eight of the top U.S. Senate races: **TEXAS **– Senator **Ted Cruz** (R) faces Congressman **Colin Allred** (D) who is backed by a mountain of liberal cash. Senate Democrats named Cruz as their #1 Target to flip a state from red to blue. A recent Emerson College poll shows that Allred's cash has pushed him to within 4 points. Now Ted Cruz is out with TV ads that expose how Colin Allred voted against a bill to keep boys out of girls' sports. **MONTANA** – Ex-Navy SEAL **Tim Sheehy** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jon Tester** (D) in the race that could strip the Democrats of their majority. Tester is the #1 recipient of lobbyist money and he's been a rubber stamp for the Biden-Harris agenda. Tester has tricked Montana voters for years, but they aren't being fooled this time. The Real Clear Politics polling average has Sheehy leading Tester by 5 points, which has Democrats on high alert. **WISCONSIN** – Businessman **Eric Hovde** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Tammy Baldwin** (D) in a presidential battleground state. Unlike many vulnerable Democrats running this year, Baldwin has actually embraced Kamala Harris and her extreme positions. Despite being attacked with millions on the other side, Hovde is exposing Baldwin's record and making the case for change. He trailed by 8 points back in June, but cut Baldwin's lead down to 4 points. **NEVADA** – Combat Army veteran **Sam Brown** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jacky Rosen** (D). Brown nearly burned to death after he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban, and his vehicle hit a roadside bomb. But after 3 years and 30 surgeries, he recovered and is now running for the U.S. Senate. Brown trails Rosen by single digits according to recent polls, but the race will tighten as Brown spends his war chest and voters learn about the choice they have in this race.

A recent poll shows Scott leading by 3 points, but he's out swinging – exposing how "Socialist Debbie" backs higher taxes on Florida families while giving tax breaks to illegal immigrants. **OHIO** – Businessman **Bernie Moreno** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Sherrod Brown** (D) in the most expensive Senate race in the nation. Progressive donors are pouring money into the Buckeye State to save their favorite liberal. Sherrod Brown featured a Republican in a TV ad who supports him, but the man is actually a Democrat. This is what Moreno is up against – lies, lies, and more lies – yet he only trails Brown by 3 points. **MISSOURI** – Senator **Josh Hawley** (R) faces Marine veteran **Lucas Kunce** (D) who is pretending to be a centrist. In a recent debate, Kunce refused to say if he was going to vote for Kamala Harris for President, which is laughable given his liberal record. The fact that he would try to hide his support for Harris shows what low regard he has for Missouri voters. Recent polls show Hawley with the lead, but he's being outspent 2-to-1, so conservatives can't sleep on the race. **ARIZONA** – Former TV news anchor **Kari Lake** (R) is taking on Congressman **Ruben Gallego** (D) to fill the open seat held by retiring Senator Kyrsten Sinema (I). Gallego is one of the most liberal politicians in Congress – even to the left of Nancy Pelosi. Gallego voted against border security while voting to give voting rights to illegal immigrants. ---
We've seen time and time again that the Lord has established the steps of Let Us Worship, and has conformed our plans to His will. Time after time, God led us INTO THE HEART of the heartbreak, where His presence is needed most. The images coming out wake of Hurricane Helene are heartbreaking. Entire communities have been wiped out and peoples lives have been up ended. In only God's timing, we are scheduled to hold revivals in Georgia and North Carolina just days after Hurricane Helene ravaged the area.

I have updates on a variety of things, so this is going to be long. Please bear with me.
### Heading to North Carolina
Tomorrow, several of us from the True the Vote team head to North Carolina. It’s a long story for a different day, but back in 2022, after we became aware of how trackable we all are (through our geospatial/cell phone project), Gregg Phillips and I began to work on solutions to increase personal privacy. That research turned into a company called Klok. Klok’s product offerings now include anonymous hotspots and CBRS (Citizens Broadband Radio Services) radios. These CBRS radio can extend Starlink signals for miles. So, we are headed there to help extend cell coverage to thousands of people who are too far away to pick up Starlink signal. Maybe that’s TMI, but I wanted you to know what’s happening. I will keep you posted.
We are also working on duplicating the VoteAlert project platform to launch another version of the platform focused on relief efforts. We’re calling it CPR (Citizen Patriot Response). People will be able to call or write for help using the app or toll-free hotline, and God-willing, we will be able to connect them with the resources they need by tapping into the growing network of amazing patriots who are pulling together to save our fellow Americans. Will keep you posted on this, too.
|
---
### Elections in Hurricane Helene Disaster Areas
A bit of good news. I’ve spoken with leadership in North Carolina regarding the upcoming election. One key leader told me “RFK, Jr. saved our elections”. She explained that his removal from the ballot caused a change in processing that altered the timeline for paper ballot production and storage, which resulted in ballot materials for all 25 of the most heavily impacted counties being spared from the hurricane. No damage. Setting up polling places, receiving ballots, etc, will still be a challenge, but the necessary materials appear to be intact. Nothing short of a miracle. We all know that is not the focus right now, but still, it was good to hear.
As to how TTV will be able to help with elections in the storm-ravaged parts of North Carolina, Tennessee, Georgia, and Florida, I don’t know, but I have some ideas. I hope to learn more while I’m there on the ground.
|

### The Trial of Tina Peters
|
---
Scott Crabtree/The Grand Junction Daily Sentinel via AP, Pool, File
Up until just a few days ago, I was not aware of Tina Peters’ full story. I thought I knew it. I didn’t. What happened in a Colorado courtroom this Thursday was more than a miscarriage of justice. It was evil.
Tina Peters attempted to expose corruption within the election process she was responsible for overseeing.
The result? A 69-year-old American with no criminal record, a Gold Star mom, who lost two additional family members during her initial incarceration (which is in itself unbelievable), who was brutalized by law enforcement (video to prove it), and was not allowed to present evidence in her case, was sentenced to 9 years in prison.
Why? To send a message to us all. To break us down and shut us up. Don’t let them.
Please consider making a donation to [Tina’s Give. Send. Go. account.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.UJcOIEsxQ3qr5lEWJDDC4i7EZHNYvjjxZlYJXAiadfTLpYw2WO3qfNBIjy3E73G-erpsLcHTBYNWt7zh6aM5bmHvCZrbEpEN0Zka6QO0xBaXZ5jwUZPa5m3P4jLVFZpr__N2PiloftwhWZWsMXrsljpuZlDa_yU2v4Gm74RZqU5mO9QevalBX2snKTEE5CKr6WZiOINiQEVdDff_nvmTKCs6B43nFmj98BTmqsZL59Focbc28IKIKaAHLmZZH8oOtBF6TVKWae_OMV7SM_kvvm7MR1XRjoAuQshsmVfBNbllb7hBHBocTaH3y8ruASIa/4ac/E7kTk9PzRKKbTNraDhP-Vw/h11/h001.x7077EwpGPgSI1iFODo-cadFqqvIEfn9ctOzSU-DV14) Her legal bills are overwhelming. You can read more about her case there, too.
|

### DeKalb County GA Republican Party v. Raffensperger (aka The Dominion Encryption Keys lawsuit)
This case was brought in the hope that the court would require the state of Georgia to follow election laws in the securing of election equipment. In their case, they proved that Dominion encryption keys (passwords) are, in fact, publicly exposed and readily available. The case was heard on Monday. Wendi Mahoney wrote a great article for us, detailing the play by play of the trial. [You can read it here. ](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.bYZLwP2tKNW52PF5H5Fs6e_tt3v5FcyxfBAwX8eOipHooPfC2JOZFHvb9vT4gIDC5bEhq7L2hjDnXP8MKSU_jWqs5wQKevPtUPChBSY2kRGDO-oE5ZGP-fpqyFxZ0bkBCnbGjV3COcSIHVrs_4SsliKeagPNL13nyrOh5SBAftUoRoVhEPXJ4MEIvcFhPe9F9zPSOuvUNiv6Pvntk3DOdkVgDQ9QK17PXcDxIQi2jsKw4HZx4_RH0tqanPYakuAsksKTGp9UWcLKsJyNeKBiHXEo-8hdHmGGk_pmFJcMeTg6qOafZbnOb_Hwc1SqDeTVHvY4QUl2_c07UhQve_HnT75AN752qjUkqbBskwlaR5b4JERpUuZuCuSoatZ24tCt4Tb1UhvYxStTBHbkr_XAi7bBG4K5B68tc_SnY2VaDgI/4ac/E7kTk9PzRKKbTNraDhP-Vw/h12/h001.TTODgl9_U0JYeoUMgZauBLSWHZGCvYPLMngwGLUsNGQ)
Unfortunately, the case was dismissed on Friday. This does not mean that the problem isn’t real. The problem is real, and it remains. The court’s opinion was that the DeKalb had no “clear legal right to their demanded relief”.
Clearly, this is disheartening. BUT, much like with ballot dropboxes, now that the problem has been made clear, there will be millions of informed citizens ready to engage if there is evidence of process exploitation.
In 2020, the evidence was there, but we didn’t understand what we were looking at. Now, we do.
|
---
### A CALL TO SERVICE
The best possible deterrent to election fraud is an engaged citizenry, ready to serve, to ask questions, and to demand accountability. If you want to work in your local elections, please contact them and get involved. Your community needs you! You can find out more about connecting with your county or local municipality on our [State Election Info page. ](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.bYZLwP2tKNW52PF5H5Fs6WslQOS_dvFTVUCyttphx2eqMFGrqEul_JBY9g87xYnG4bpyVi6EvPPoIEYajQ6g6ULZTQ5ne6DT0sS-wGVGaAZEt0WkdBM-k4q5S-v2zFaaE8LCXeTktQld8vL30CtRBqLWiU7mMtQNPN3XscYZATTgdVrs7GYTjW6H3S1aG9gewLW2WVmshQJQxz7ygNukqW7cB86AyByWNyfXiXolGYhZ6gFsSKBiTAnDc2je8bKu66BlNss4mD2RIvfmbojOMV0SMQU9QrrJsqoIhI2_iDVaUGmP4fBRmhzL9fbZdrzI/4ac/E7kTk9PzRKKbTNraDhP-Vw/h13/h001.iMFY5-UKRfctUF9kFs6iG33zlpPtfjgIzHcv4lNMngQ)

### The Rest of the Story ...
There’s much more I’d love to share, but the above is already a lot to take in. Bottom line, we are well-positioned and watching on many fronts; voter roll activity, voter support, polling place support, ballot dropbox security, just to name a few. As the days tick down, waiting, watching, reporting, and being prepared to act, is the right posture for TTV as an election integrity organization. But for each of us as individuals, there is nothing more important than voting and helping ensure all our family and friends vote, too. We can keep bad actors at bay and still lose if voters don’t show up.
Vote. Serve. Pray. Pray. And Pray again.
Never quit. Keep the faith. Stay strong. Together, there’s nothing we can’t do.
Ever onward -

clean_body: Vote. Serve. Pray. | | | October 05, 2024 | | | Hi Friend - I have updates on a variety of things, so this is going to be long. Please bear with me. Heading to North Carolina Tomorrow, several of us from the True the Vote team head to North Carolina. It’s a long story for a different day, but back in 2022, after we became aware of how trackable we all are (through our geospatial/cell phone project), Gregg Phillips and I began to work on solutions to increase personal privacy. That research turned into a company called Klok. Klok’s product offerings now include anonymous hotspots and CBRS (Citizens Broadband Radio Services) radios. These CBRS radio can extend Starlink signals for miles. So, we are headed there to help extend cell coverage to thousands of people who are too far away to pick up Starlink signal. Maybe that’s TMI, but I wanted you to know what’s happening. I will keep you posted. We are also working on duplicating the VoteAlert project platform to launch another version of the platform focused on relief efforts. We’re calling it CPR (Citizen Patriot Response). People will be able to call or write for help using the app or toll-free hotline, and God-willing, we will be able to connect them with the resources they need by tapping into the growing network of amazing patriots who are pulling together to save our fellow Americans. Will keep you posted on this, too. | Elections in Hurricane Helene Disaster Areas A bit of good news. I’ve spoken with leadership in North Carolina regarding the upcoming election. One key leader told me “RFK, Jr. saved our elections”. She explained that his removal from the ballot caused a change in processing that altered the timeline for paper ballot production and storage, which resulted in ballot materials for all 25 of the most heavily impacted counties being spared from the hurricane. No damage. Setting up polling places, receiving ballots, etc, will still be a challenge, but the necessary materials appear to be intact. Nothing short of a miracle. We all know that is not the focus right now, but still, it was good to hear. As to how TTV will be able to help with elections in the storm-ravaged parts of North Carolina, Tennessee, Georgia, and Florida, I don’t know, but I have some ideas. I hope to learn more while I’m there on the ground. | ALERT: Check Your Voter Record We continue to receive reports from engaged voters who’ve taken the challenge to check their state record and have found their registration was either inactive or missing altogether. Please take two minutes and check your voter registration record. You can check right here 👇 Chances are that you’ll find your record with no problem, but why take the chance? If you find your registration to be inaccurate in any way, call your county, or go by the office, as soon as possible to correct the issue. If your registration is missing, you will need to re-register before the registration cut-off. | Ballot Dropbox Transparency Project Thank you to everyone who is helping support this effort. We traveled across Wisconsin this week, collecting exact dropbox locations and meeting with engaged citizens and law enforcement. Next stop, Michigan. | The goal is to enhance ballot dropbox security by providing video livestreams of the dropboxes, so that America can see the boxes for themselves. True the Vote is providing camera gear, hotspots, and streaming support. The team at will host livestream video feeds, along with archival of the footage. It’s been great to see that several counties, including Maricopa County, Arizona and counties across Ohio, are also livestreaming their ballot dropbox cameras. We plan to feature those streams on , as well. We’ve also written to states, counties, cities, and other municipalities, requesting ballot dropbox video footage, from the time the dropboxes are opened until close on Election Day. Unlike what happened in 2020, we are now very well prepared on this front. | VoteAlert We are seeing a steady growth in the use of VoteAlert. If you don’t already have the app on your phone ... or don’t even know what I’m referring to ... please check out . This is a great way to stay in touch, get questions answered, and get help if you need it. If you are part of an organization that would like to use the app to coordinate with volunteers and voters, please contact us. Would love to work with you. | | Election Observer Quick Reference Guides Are Ready! guides focus on essential “must knows” for anyone working at a polling place. Each guide was meticulously researched by an amazingly diligent group of volunteers who spent hundreds of hours compiling information. Thank you!! Amazing job, team!! | | The Trial of Tina Peters | Scott Crabtree/The Grand Junction Daily Sentinel via AP, Pool, File Up until just a few days ago, I was not aware of Tina Peters’ full story. I thought I knew it. I didn’t. What happened in a Colorado courtroom this Thursday was more than a miscarriage of justice. It was evil. Tina Peters attempted to expose corruption within the election process she was responsible for overseeing. The result? A 69-year-old American with no criminal record, a Gold Star mom, who lost two additional family members during her initial incarceration (which is in itself unbelievable), who was brutalized by law enforcement (video to prove it), and was not allowed to present evidence in her case, was sentenced to 9 years in prison. Why? To send a message to us all. To break us down and shut us up. Don’t let them. Please consider making a donation to Her legal bills are overwhelming. You can read more about her case there, too. | DeKalb County GA Republican Party v. Raffensperger (aka The Dominion Encryption Keys lawsuit) This case was brought in the hope that the court would require the state of Georgia to follow election laws in the securing of election equipment. In their case, they proved that Dominion encryption keys (passwords) are, in fact, publicly exposed and readily available. The case was heard on Monday. Wendi Mahoney wrote a great article for us, detailing the play by play of the trial. Unfortunately, the case was dismissed on Friday. This does not mean that the problem isn’t real. The problem is real, and it remains. The court’s opinion was that the DeKalb had no “clear legal right to their demanded relief”. Clearly, this is disheartening. BUT, much like with ballot dropboxes, now that the problem has been made clear, there will be millions of informed citizens ready to engage if there is evidence of process exploitation. In 2020, the evidence was there, but we didn’t understand what we were looking at. Now, we do. | A CALL TO SERVICE The best possible deterrent to election fraud is an engaged citizenry, ready to serve, to ask questions, and to demand accountability. If you want to work in your local elections, please contact them and get involved. Your community needs you! You can find out more about connecting with your county or local municipality on our | The Rest of the Story ... There’s much more I’d love to share, but the above is already a lot to take in. Bottom line, we are well-positioned and watching on many fronts; voter roll activity, voter support, polling place support, ballot dropbox security, just to name a few. As the days tick down, waiting, watching, reporting, and being prepared to act, is the right posture for TTV as an election integrity organization. But for each of us as individuals, there is nothing more important than voting and helping ensure all our family and friends vote, too. We can keep bad actors at bay and still lose if voters don’t show up. Vote. Serve. Pray. Pray. And Pray again. Never quit. Keep the faith. Stay strong. Together, there’s nothing we can’t do. body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
We’ve officially hit the one-month mark—just one month until Election Day.
Now, I want you to think about this sprint we’re in.
Yes, it’s going to be hard.
Yes, it’s going to be exhausting.
But this is the moment to leave it all on the field. As Tim Walz said during his VP acceptance speech, “We can sleep when we’re dead.”
We need you in this national fight. Will you contribute today to help us power through the final stretch? Every dollar raised now will go directly into marketing against Jim Jordan and his dangerous agenda. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241005_30_days_out_link1]
Think of the reward waiting for us as we push through these last 30 days and give it everything we’ve got.
Imagine waking up on November 6th knowing we’ve left the nightmare of Trump’s biggest ally, the ULTRA-MAGA treasonous traitor jackass Jordan behind for good.
We can kick Jim Jordan and his judiciary clown show out of office and deliver the House to Kamala Harris and the Democrats, so we can really get things done for the working class.
Make no mistake: the combination of Trump, Vance, and Jordan is an existential threat to our freedoms and democracy.
But this next month isn’t just about focusing on the danger—it's about the incredible opportunity in front of us.
We have the chance to build something better, a brighter, happier future for all of us.
We can build a world where kids don’t go hungry, where books and culture are celebrated instead of banned, where people can live in peace without fear and marry who they love.
We can build a country where healthcare is a right, not a privilege...
Where people have enough income not just to get by but to get ahead. I want people to live a good life. I want Eve to have the opportunity to succeed and enjoy life to the fullest...
We need to protect voting rights and body autonomy for every citizen...
We deserve a future where no one has to live under the threat of Christian nationalism and political violence.
This is the most important congressional race in the country because we’re not just fighting to defeat Jim Jordan—we’re fighting to transform this country into a place where opportunity, freedom, and equality thrive.
Let’s bring the joy back. Let’s bring civility and sanity back!
Contribute today, and help us cross the finish line with the resources we need to win. We have 30 days to make history. Are you with me? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241005_30_days_out_link2]
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

I'm Paula Collins, and I'm the Democratic Candidate for Congress in NY-21. I'm going to Congress because we need a policy on climate change.
Specifically, we need Congress to act to help communities remediate or mitigate the effects of climate change. We need alternative energy sources, sustainable housing, new building materials, alternative modes of transportation. We need to harden our food supply, protect our water, and ensure clean air. We need infrastructure to avert flooding, wind damage, and erosion.
Let's be clear: FEMA is not a climate policy. It is a disaster relief fund. By the time people are asking for FEMA funding, the clock has run out on efforts to remediate or mitigate the effects of climate change.
One would think that the depletion of FEMA funds would signal Congressional action. Instead of communities turning to FEMA as a piggy bank, Congress needs to scaffold climate change responses to be proactive as well as reactive.
The fact that we don't have a current policy on climate change is a failure of the Republican-led Congress, of which my opponent, Elise Stefanik, is the Republican Conference Chair.
Since Hurricane Helene swept through several states, we have heard [Republicans make the outlandish claim that FEMA funds had been depleted due to diversion of funds to migrant shelters](https://substack.com/redirect/a0aecda1-f0bb-44f2-85bd-9d267954959a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Not true. And it was the Republicans who, just weeks prior, [had voted against an increase in funding for FEMA](https://substack.com/redirect/21ced003-c338-4137-88fa-5e4af2509e9d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
It's a deadly blame game that the Republicans are playing. On Republican Conference Chair Elise Stefanik's watch, 220+ lives have been lost. Moreover, tens of thousands of men, women, and children have lost the only communities and homes they have known.
Stefanik had it in her power to do something. She did not.
Rome, New York, experienced firsthand what it's like to recover from a storm with no FEMA funding to help. When a devastating tornado hit, Stefanik was busy at the Republican National Convention. She eventually caught on and sounded off about, to no avail.
Rome is new in Stefanik's district. That experience should have motivated her to shore up FEMA funding.
It did not.
(Clarification: Some money was made available for New Yorkers impacted by flooding that happened in August due to the remnants of Hurricane Debby. But not for the flooding that occurred in September.)
Sorry Matt Gaetz, and others, whose states are now under mud and water, with little or no funding in sight. Call Elise. It's on her. She is the Republican Conference Chair. She decides what gets to the floor of the House and what does not.
Climate change did not make it to the House floor.
Storm relief did not make it to the House floor.
We must not perpetuate the dysfunction of Congress, nor that of the Republican Conference Leader.
It's time for a change.
Elise Stefanik has had since 2015 to introduce a policy on climate change. She has not.
Please support my candidacy to represent New York's 21st Congressional District. Together, let's get a policy that remediates, mitigates, and actually helps middle-class families not only survive -- but thrive -- well into our 21st century of climate change.
www.paulacollinsforcongress.com

** Bank Your Vote Early
------------------------------------------------------------

** Let’s Secure Victory Together
------------------------------------------------------------

Every Republican must make an impact early in the voting cycle. Between October 21 and November 3, we must come together, make our voices heard, and demonstrate our strength at the polls. Our mission is simple: get Republicans elected—and to do that effectively, we need to put points on the board as early as possible.

Why Vote Early Instead of on Election Day?

Early voting is not just a tradition; it's a winning strategy. By voting early, you're empowering the Republican party to secure victory. Your early vote is a powerful tool in our arsenal.

“The future belongs to those brave enough to release the past and embrace today without hesitation.” - unknown wise person

Voting early enables the Republican Party to Maximize Voter Turnout.

Early voting shows enthusiasm and commitment. Just as importantly, it helps your local Republican team focus on GOTV efforts. Once you’ve voted early, they can mark you down and concentrate on helping other Republicans who haven’t yet cast their ballots.

This strategy maximizes our efficiency by ensuring every Republican votes. Let’s secure our future by taking action today.

Vote early and bank your vote!!
